title: Applied AI Architect, Beneficial Deployment
description:
## About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
## About Beneficial Deployments
Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.
## About the Role
We're looking for an Applied AI Architect to join Beneficial Deployments, focused on helping nonprofits and research institutes in APAC get real value from Claude. You'll be the technical lead for a portfolio of partners, working alongside our Account Executives from first conversation through deployment, and you'll support a wider set of accounts through learning sessions. With nonprofits, you'll find where Claude makes a real difference to their mission and their operations. With research institutes, you'll help researchers and the teams who support them use Claude in work they can check and stand behind. You'll design solutions that fit each partner's budget, data and teams, and turn early pilots into lasting adoption. What works for one partner becomes something others across the region and beyond can use.
## Responsibilities
• Serve as the primary technical advisor to a portfolio of nonprofits and research institutes from discovery through deployment, turning their priorities into scoped use cases with clear measures of success.
• Partner with Account Executives on account plans, discovery and technical evaluation.
• Design and demo solutions with Claude, the API and Claude Code and Science for nonprofits and research institutes
• Help researchers evaluate Claude on their own questions and data before they rely on it, and be plain about its limits.
• Guide partners through security review, data governance and procurement, including rules that differ by country and limits on how research data can be used.
• Support a wider portfolio of accounts through learning sessions and enablement.
• Run workshops and trainings that build AI fluency across partner teams, from program staff to research groups.
• Build reusable assets (reference designs, connectors, prompt and eval templates) so one partner's work helps the next.
• Spot patterns across partners, bring field insight back to Product and Research, and help partners measure what changed.
• Travel up to 30% to partner sites for workshops, technical deep dives and relationship building.
## You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have
• 7-10 years in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, forward-deployed engineering or technical consulting.
• A track record of getting lean, skeptical or slow-moving teams with many stakeholders to adopt technology and keep using it, including working through how they buy and govern it.
• Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs: you have built and evaluated working prototypes or agents, and can guide a partner's own engineers on architecture and evals. You don't need to write production code.
• The ability to earn the trust of researchers and other specialists: you can show how you tested something, where it fails and what you don't know yet.
• Clear written and spoken communication across a broad audience. The ability to explain technical tradeoffs to program leads, researchers, operations staff and executives.
• Patience with long buying and partnership cycles, a knack for knowing how to make them go smoothly, and real care for public benefit.
• A track record of agency and autonomy: you spot what needs doing before anyone asks, agree that it matters, drive it to a finished result and know when to pull others in.
• Comfort operating in ambiguity: you bring clarity to fuzzy problems, wear multiple hats and do whatever it takes to further the mission.
• Bonus if you've worked with or at nonprofits, foundations, research institutes or other mission-driven organizations, worked in a sales team, built multilingual products, or worked with partners in more than one country.
## Logistics
Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.
We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
## How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
## Come work with us!
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
description:
As vCluster’s AI Infrastructure Specialist, you will work directly with customers at the earliest and most critical stage of their journey: from bare metal GPU nodes through to a production-ready deployment. This is not a traditional professional services role; you operate pre-sale as part of a proof of value engagement scoped to reach production. You will be one of the first team members a neocloud or AI Factory engages with at a technical depth, and the playbooks you develop will scale the motion for the next hire and customer.
vCluster is gaining rapid traction with GPU AI Clouds and enterprises building AI Factories: organizations that need to offer Kubernetes as a managed service on bare metal GPU infrastructure, and need to do it fast. This role exists to make that happen.
As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, your role will include:
Lead Technical Deployments: Drive end-to-end technical deployments for GPU neocloud and AI Factory customers, from initial bare metal configuration to a validated vCluster environment.
Infrastructure Optimization: Configure and troubleshoot bare metal GPU node infrastructure, including CNI configuration, GPU Operator setup, distributed storage backends, and RDMA/InfiniBand.
Validation: Deploy and validate Kubernetes and vCluster to provide GPU-powered managed K8s.
Knowledge Transfer: Work alongside customer teams to build self-sufficiency, ensuring they can operate and grow the platform independently.
Scaling through Documentation: Document reusable playbooks and deployment architectures so your learnings become the next customer's head start.
Feedback Loop: Collaborate with Engineering and Product to surface recurring infrastructure challenges, acting as a direct feedback loop from the field into the roadmap.
Strategic Partnering: Join Sales in the pre-sales process where deep infrastructure work is required to achieve a meaningful proof of value.
## This role could be a fit for you if you bring:
Production K8s Mastery: 5+ years of experience deploying and operating Kubernetes in production, ideally on bare metal or in high-complexity environments.
GPU Fluency: Practical knowledge of NVIDIA GPU Operators, CUDA tooling, and systems-level configuration for GPU nodes.
Networking Fundamentals: Deep understanding of CNI plugins, overlay networks, load balancing, and connectivity diagnosis in layered environments.
Storage Expertise: Experience with persistent volume configuration, CSI drivers, and distributed systems like Ceph, Rook, Weka, or Longhorn.
Operational Agility: Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you are often writing the playbook in real time.
Modern Tech Mindset: You thrive in environments that reject legacy tech and prefer a modern stack where you can solve a variety of problems from pipelines to internal services.
## Bonus points for:
Automation Skills: Experience writing automation scripts with Bash, Python, or Go.
Kubernetes Depth: Relevant certifications such as CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) or experience writing Kubernetes Operators.
AI/ML Familiarity: Experience with inference serving, GPU scheduling, and the tooling around LLM deployment.
Documentation: Experience building AI Automation in documentation to contribute to a shared knowledge base.
## About vCluster Labs
We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.
We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.
We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.
## Benefits
## We offer the following benefits:
Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.
Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).
Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.
Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.
## Culture & Values
At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:
Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.
Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.
Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.
Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.
Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.
## Compensation Range: $140K - $165K

title: AI Infra System Engineer
description:
CIeNET is seeking an AI Infrastructure Systems Support Engineer to support large-scale server infrastructure deployment and operations.
In this role, you will troubleshoot Linux-based infrastructure, investigate automated server deployment failures, diagnose networking and hardware-related issues, and collaborate with global engineering teams to ensure smooth data center operations.
This position is ideal for professionals with hands-on experience in Linux system administration, networking, infrastructure support, and incident troubleshooting.
## Requirements
## Key Responsibilities
• Monitor, investigate, and resolve infrastructure deployment and system support tickets.
• Troubleshoot Linux operating system issues, configuration problems, and automated deployment failures.
• Analyze system logs, kernel messages, networking diagnostics, and deployment workflow failures.
• Diagnose DHCP, DNS, TCP/IP, PXE boot, and network connectivity issues.
• Identify potential server hardware, NIC, BIOS, BMC, and firmware failures, escalating issues to specialized engineering teams when required.
• Support troubleshooting of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized infrastructure environments.
• Collaborate with global engineering teams to resolve infrastructure incidents.
• Maintain accurate ticket documentation, troubleshooting runbooks, and shift handoff reports.
• Participate in rotating shifts to support global infrastructure operations.
## Required Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
• Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience with Linux operating systems.
• Minimum 2 years of experience with computer networking.
• Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP (IPv4/IPv6), and network troubleshooting.
• Familiarity with server hardware components, BIOS, BMC, NICs, and firmware.
• Practical experience troubleshooting Kubernetes environments, including workload scheduling and networking.
• Experience using ticketing systems for incident tracking and escalation.
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting capabilities.
• Ability to communicate technical issues clearly and document incident resolutions.
• Ability to work independently in a remote, shift-based environment.
## Preferred Qualifications
• Experience supporting data center infrastructure or large-scale server deployments.
• Familiarity with PXE boot, netboot, and automated OS provisioning.
• Experience with Bash or Python scripting.
• Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, K3s, or container networking.
• Experience with DCIM/IPAM solutions such as NetBox.
• Experience working with globally distributed support teams.
## Working Environment
This is a primarily remote role supporting global infrastructure operations through a follow-the-sun model.
Engineers will work approximately 40 hours per week across rotating eight-hour shifts. Schedules may include weekends and holidays based on operational coverage needs.
Successful candidates must be reliable, responsive, technically capable, and comfortable coordinating with engineering teams across different time zones.
## Benefits
• Extended Healthcare Plan (Medical, Disability, Dental & Vision)
• Group Life - AD&D - Critical Illness Insurance
• Pension Plan
• Paid Time Off
• Work From Home

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
## About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
## The Role
We are looking for full stack engineers to build fast across BJAK's AI Neobank app.
This role is for product-minded engineers who can move across frontend, backend, internal tools and customer journeys to turn ideas into working products quickly.
## What You'll Own
Build and ship full product features across frontend, backend, APIs and databases.
Create customer and internal workflows for onboarding, accounts, payments, rewards, travel, FX, support automation, KYC and risk.
Turn ambiguous product problems into working systems with clean UX and reliable backend logic.
Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI engineers to launch fast and improve after release.
Build internal tools and automation that reduce manual work and help teams operate at scale.
Own your work beyond release: monitor, debug, learn and improve.
## What We're Looking For
Strong full stack engineering experience with real shipped products.
Comfortable across frontend, backend, APIs, databases and production debugging.
Good frontend execution using React, Next.js, Vue or similar modern stack.
Good backend fundamentals around APIs, data models, authentication, integrations and reliability.
Strong product sense and ability to simplify messy workflows.
Able to work fast with ambiguity and own outcomes end-to-end.
## This Role Is Not For
Engineers who only want to work on one narrow layer.
People who need complete specs before starting.
Developers who ship UI without understanding backend or operations impact.
## Candidates who avoid production support.
People who make vague claims without showing real shipped work.
## The Bar
We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.
## Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Portugal. We are hiring for this market specifically, so applicants should already be based in Portugal.
## Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
## Interview Process
## Our process is designed to move fast:
## 1. Online assessment or practical task
## 2. Technical interview
## 3. CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

We are seeking an exceptional Data Analyst to join our DIG (Data & Insights Group) team. Think of us like bridge builders: we build the support beams, develop the infrastructure, and create the custom analyses that allow other teams to leverage data to make decisions.

description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
## About the Engineering team
The Engineering team builds systems that power Affirm’s mission. We take pride in our craft, building reliable, performant, and scalable solutions that touch every part of the business. Whether we’re enabling new ways to pay, ensuring our platforms can scale to the most demanding levels in the industry, or developing seamless servicing experiences, our focus is on solving complex problems through exceptional engineering.
You will be matched with a team after completing the interview evaluation process. Your recruiter will work closely with you throughout the process to understand your interests and experience to find the strongest team fit.
## What you’ll do
• With the support of your team’s tech lead and manager, you will break down larger projects into individual tasks, deliver them in multiple phases, and collaborate with others to ensure timely delivery of your work.
• You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
• You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
• You will contribute to a sense of community on your team by engaging in growth and development activities such as participation in the interview process.
## What we look for
• You have a total of 1.5+ years of experience as a software engineer.
• You have experience designing, developing and launching backend systems and are proficient in one of Python or Kotlin.
• You are familiar with the building blocks of distributed systems, and the technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
• You have mastered taking a simple problem or business scenario into a solution that interacts with multiple software components, and executing on it by writing clear, easily understood, well tested and extensible code.
• You are comfortable navigating a large code base, debugging others' code, and providing feedback to other engineers through code reviews.
• Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
• You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
Total rewards
We believe the people building honest financial products at Affirm should share in its success. That's why our total rewards are designed to support your health, growth, financial well-being, and future.
In service of our mission, we reward employees through a combination of base pay, equity (from parent company), and comprehensive benefits.

title: AI Tutor, Chemistry - Temporary
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
## AI TUTOR, CHEMISTRY - TEMPORARY
In this role, you will help enhance Grok by providing high-quality data annotations, labels, and inputs focused on chemistry. You will draw on your expertise in areas such as organic, inorganic, physical, and analytical chemistry, biochemistry, computational chemistry, and materials chemistry to select challenging problems, evaluate model outputs, identify errors in chemical reasoning, and produce clear, rigorous solutions and explanations. Your work will help train Grok to distinguish flawed or unsupported reasoning from solutions that are chemically sound, logically rigorous, and scientifically accurate.
## RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Develop and evaluate high-quality scientific training and evaluation datasets using proprietary AI development platforms, applying advanced chemistry expertise to assess model reasoning, factual accuracy, and scientific problem-solving capabilities.
• Play a pivotal role in supporting and contributing to the training of new tasks, working closely with the technical staff to ensure the successful development and implementation of cutting-edge initiatives/technologies.
• Collaborate with the technical staff to enhance the design of efficient annotation tools.
• Design, solve, and critically evaluate complex chemistry problems spanning advanced graduate-level concepts and emerging research areas, identifying limitations in AI model reasoning and developing scientifically rigorous evaluations to advance model capabilities.
• Choose problems from fields across chemistry that align with your expertise in specialized subdomains, including, but not limited to, organic chemistry, physical chemistry, analytical chemistry, inorganic chemistry, computational chemistry, polymer chemistry, nuclear chemistry, or medicinal chemistry, where you can confidently provide detailed solutions and evaluate model responses.
• Regularly interpret, analyze, and execute tasks based on given instructions.
• Operate in a fast-paced environment with rapidly changing priorities.
## POSITION DETAILS:
This is a temporary position with SpaceXSI, for the length of time as stated, and is subject to change with minimal notice as business needs dictate.
• LENGTH OF POSITION: 6 months (extensions or conversion to a permanent role may be available based on business needs).
• LOCATION: Remote (United States, United Kingdom, Canada, India, and Australia); for US-based candidates, please note that we are unable to hire in Wyoming and Illinois at this time.
## BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
• PhD in a chemistry-related field; OR a master's degree with 3+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas: research/laboratory, policy/regulatory, strategy and management (in STEM), editorial/scientific writing, scientific communications, scientific instrumentation.
• English proficiency at CEFR C1 level or higher.
## PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
• Expertise in chemistry-related subdomains including, but not limited to organic chemistry, physical chemistry, analytical chemistry, inorganic chemistry, organometallic chemistry, biochemistry, nuclear chemistry, computational/theoretical chemistry, polymer/materials chemistry, medicinal chemistry, catalysis, surface/colloid chemistry, or drug discovery.
• Strong ability to navigate various information resources, databases, and online resources.
• Strong passion for and commitment to technological advancements and innovation.
• Advanced expertise in chemistry, demonstrated by multiple publications, including at least one first-author paper, in reputable peer-reviewed journals.
• Relevant industry experience in chemistry-related fields such as drug development, consulting, biotechnology, energy (esp. oil/gas), materials/polymer science, chemical manufacturing/regulation, or computational chemistry.
• Prior data annotation or teaching experience (as a professor, teacher, or tutor).
• Patents or other clear evidence of technological innovation.
• Experience in academic, technical or professional writing, or journalism.
## ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
• This role may be offered as a full-time or part-time position depending on role/business needs and candidate availability; full-time positions are preferred and require working standard business hours in your local time zone.
• We are unable to provide visa sponsorship.
• Must be willing to travel to a SpaceXSI site.
## COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:
US-based candidates: $45/hour - $75/hour depending on factors including relevant experience, skills, education, geographic location, and qualifications. International candidates: Information will be provided to you during the recruitment process.
Benefits vary based on employment type, location, and jurisdiction. Benefits for eligible US-based positions include health insurance, 401(k) plan, and paid sick leave. Specific details and role-specific information will be provided to you during the interview process.
SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

description:
We are on a mission to build the AI-native platform for finance—a multi-agent system that reimagines how investment teams make decisions and empowers them to move faster, think deeper, and operate smarter. Our backend engineers are at the heart of this transformation, building the robust infrastructure and services that power intelligent workflows, turning fragmented financial data into actionable insights with the help of autonomous agents.
## What You’ll Do
• Architect and develop scalable backend systems using Python and modern cloud-native tools.
• Build APIs, orchestration layers, and data pipelines that support autonomous agents and real-time financial analytics.
• Translate complex financial logic into clear, maintainable, and performant code.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including ML, data, and product— to integrate LLMs, financial logic, and user workflows.
• Own the performance, reliability, and maintainability of mission-critical systems.
• Drive best practices in architectural decisions, testing, devops practices, IaC and system observability.
Note: This remote position requires monthly travel to the Bay area or Seattle for in person team meetings.

• Have 3–7 years of backend engineering experience
• Have built and scaled production-grade backend systems for data-intensive or real-time applications.
• Are excited about building intelligent systems with autonomous behavior, not just CRUD apps.
• Have strong proficiency in Python and experience building distributed backend systems.
• Think in abstractions and API contracts before diving into implementation, and have experience designing and consuming clean, well-structured interfaces (REST, GraphQL, or RPC).
• Have experience with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and event-driven systems (e.g., Kafka).
• Have deep understanding of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) and caching systems (e.g., Redis).
• Have a strong grasp of performance tuning, code quality, automated testing, CI/CD practices, and building systems that are secure, observable, and production-ready.
• Enjoy working on complex logic and domain modeling in high-stakes environments like fintech, trading, or enterprise SaaS.

• Exposure to financial data modeling, investment workflows, or alternative data pipelines.
## Why Join Us?
We're a fast-moving startup backed by Tier 1 VC building in a space ripe for reinvention. If you're excited about redefining how thousands of financial professionals work—using agents, not spreadsheets—you’ll fit right in.

## Fullstack Engineer - IAM Team
This role is based in Lisbon, following a Hybrid model (Remote + Presence in our Lisbon office)
SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!
We own how users access the entire product. From authentication flows to permissions and authorisation, we ensure frictionless user experiences with industry-leading security. Every single user interacts with our domain before using the rest of the product so we put a lot of effort into making our UX processes seamless, intuitive and confidence-inspiring. Our main objective at the moment is enforcing strong domain boundaries for our resources and migrating from self-developed solutions to a more integrated strategy utilizing trusted industry IAM players.
## Here's how you'll make a difference:
Take core contributor ownership on business-critical, complex projects from conception to deployment
Care deeply about outcomes including end user experience and adoption of internal features
Show your aptitude for observability and performance optimisation using tools like Sentry, DataDog, etc
Take opportunities to flex both your backend and frontend skills to ensure frictionless user experience across the stack
Collaborate deeply with other internal teams to ensure strong tooling and process adoption
Use your obsession with quality to ensure robust testing resources, team best practices, a rock-solid CI/CD process and carefully designed releases
Own the processes you design end to end - you are the steward of your projects and everyone knows it
Become a trusted collaboration partner in a modern Agile/Scrum environment supporting your team mates with thorough code reviews, architecture and implementation discussions and pair problem solving
Contribute to an enthusiastic team environment - we help, support and celebrate each other
## What makes you a great fit:
Proven track record of professional full-stack development success using Typescript + React
Robust quality mindset and deep experience with testing and release strategies
Systems-thinking mindset - you actively own processes end to end and think deeply about how they interact with other parts of the product and the people around you
Comfortable working with (or learning to work with) AI-assisted tooling such as Claude, Github Co-Pilot or Cursor
Strong observability and performance mindset and experience being able to quantify and show how your products are used
Familiarity with CI/CD and common DevOps processes
Collaborative and curious - you care deeply about your team environment and helping to make it the best it can be
## Strong communication skills in English
## What we offer*
Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days
Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, corporate discounts
Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups
And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, dog-friendly HQ
*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.
## About Us
At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.
Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.
If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

Build AI agents, workflows, tools and automations that solve real customer, product and operations problems.
Apply LLMs, retrieval, tool calling, evaluations, guardrails and automation to practical financial workflows.
Create AI-assisted experiences for onboarding, support, KYC, risk review, CRM, operations, document handling and product intelligence.
Work with product and engineering teams to identify what is worth building, then build it quickly and improve it in production.
Design around real constraints: accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, security, compliance and user trust.
Turn manual processes into reliable AI-enabled systems that can scale.

Hands-on engineering ability, not just AI strategy or management experience.
Experience building AI agents, LLM apps, RAG systems, automation workflows, copilots or AI-enabled tools.
Strong coding ability in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript or similar practical stack.

People who only want research projects with no production ownership.
Candidates who treat AI as demos instead of working systems.
Engineers who do not care about evaluation, reliability or user impact.
People who overclaim AI impact without evidence.
Builders who cannot work with product, ops and business teams.

The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:

## Data Analyst / Data Engineer – SQL, BI & Data Analytics | Remote
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
## About the Role
At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Data Analyst / Data Engineer to transform business data into reliable reporting, actionable insights, and scalable data systems.
Depending on your experience, this role may lean toward data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or a combination of these areas.
You’ll work with SQL, dashboards, reporting tools, databases, and data pipelines to help teams better understand performance and make informed business decisions.
This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to explain data clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
## What You’ll Own
## Data Analysis & Business Insights
• Collect, clean, organize, and analyze business data
• Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and performance drivers
• Translate raw data into meaningful business insights
• Investigate data questions and provide evidence-based recommendations
• Support stakeholders with ad hoc analysis and recurring reporting needs
## SQL & Data Management
• Write, maintain, and optimize SQL queries
• Extract and combine data from multiple sources
• Work with relational databases and structured datasets
• Validate datasets for completeness and accuracy
• Troubleshoot inconsistencies across reporting and source systems
## Dashboards & Business Intelligence
• Develop and maintain dashboards using tools such as:
• Power BI
• Tableau
• Looker
• Similar BI platforms
• Build recurring reports for business stakeholders
• Create clear visualizations that make complex information easier to understand
• Maintain consistent definitions and reporting logic across dashboards
## Data Pipelines & Integrations
• Build or maintain data pipelines and integrations
• Help connect business systems and reporting environments
• Support reliable movement of data between platforms
• Troubleshoot pipeline and integration issues
• Improve the scalability and reliability of data workflows
## Reporting Automation
• Automate recurring reporting and data preparation processes
• Reduce manual spreadsheet and reporting work
• Build repeatable workflows for common reporting requirements
• Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency
• Help ensure stakeholders have timely access to reliable information
## Data Quality & Reliability
• Monitor and improve data accuracy
• Identify missing, duplicated, or inconsistent information
• Validate reporting outputs against source data
• Improve processes that support reliable reporting
• Maintain organized documentation around reporting and data workflows
## Stakeholder Collaboration
• Work with business stakeholders to understand reporting requirements
• Translate business questions into analytical requirements
• Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences
• Explain trends, metrics, and recommendations in practical business terms
• Collaborate across teams to improve data accessibility and reporting
## Requirements
2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or a related role
• Strong hands-on SQL skills
• Experience with Excel and/or Google Sheets
• Experience using at least one BI or visualization platform such as:
• Power BI
• Tableau
• Looker
• Similar tools
• Familiarity with databases and data warehouses
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
• Ability to identify patterns and insights within complex datasets
• Strong attention to data accuracy and reporting reliability
• Ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
• Professional working English
• Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
## Nice to Have
• Experience with Python for data analysis or automation
• Experience building or maintaining data pipelines
• Experience integrating data from multiple systems
• Familiarity with cloud-based databases or data warehouses
• Experience automating recurring reporting workflows
• Experience with data modeling and reporting architecture
• Experience supporting business intelligence or executive reporting
## Tools & Technologies
SQL | Excel | Google Sheets | Power BI | Tableau | Looker | Python | Databases | Data Warehouses | Data Pipelines | BI & Reporting Tools
## What Makes You a Strong Fit
You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:
• Enjoy turning messy data into clear, reliable information
• Are comfortable working deeply with SQL and datasets
• Question inconsistencies instead of accepting numbers at face value
• Can move between technical analysis and business conversations
• Look for opportunities to automate repetitive reporting
• Care about data accuracy and reporting reliability
• Can explain complex findings in simple, actionable terms
• Take ownership of analytical problems from question through insight
## What a Typical Day Looks Like
Your day may include writing SQL queries, cleaning datasets, updating dashboards, investigating business trends, or automating a recurring report.
Depending on the project, you may also maintain data pipelines, troubleshoot reporting inconsistencies, work with stakeholders to define new metrics, or present findings to business leaders.
In short: you turn company data into reliable reporting, useful insights, and better business decisions.
## Key Metrics for Success
• Accuracy and reliability of reporting
• Quality and usability of dashboards
• Timely delivery of recurring reports and analysis
• SQL query and reporting efficiency
• Reduction in manual reporting processes
• Reliability of data pipelines and integrations
• Improvement in overall data quality
• Stakeholder confidence in reporting and insights

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.
After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.
Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.
## Apply Now
If you have experience with SQL, data analytics, business intelligence, dashboards, reporting, or data engineering and enjoy turning complex data into clear business insights, we’d love to hear from you.
Apply today and help build reliable data systems that support smarter business decisions.

• Translate Prototypes to Products: Collaborate closely with engineering and product teams to integrate successful prototypes into Sonar's cutting-edge products, ensuring they meet the needs of our global user base.
• Communicate and Evangelize: Clearly articulate and document complex technical concepts and research findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience and qualifications
Must have:
Advanced academic background in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field.
Strong software engineering experience (minimum 2+ years in industry) with proficiency in Python and major modern programming languages.
Practical experience with modern agentic frameworks, software automation tools, and LLM architectures.
Experience of driving research projects from initial ideation to a demonstrable prototype with a high degree of autonomy.
Hands-on experience integrating third-party tools, program analysis frameworks, or open-source libraries into functional prototypes.
Proven experience in data handling: constructing high-quality datasets, defining objective success metrics, and building robust benchmarks for new solutions.
The ability to fast context-switch and maintain momentum across multiple concurrent, fast-moving research topics.
Excellent communication skills in English, with a talent for translating complex research findings into clear, actionable artifacts for product engineering squads.
Plus:
Background in static analysis: abstract syntax trees (ASTs), code security, bug detection, etc..
Familiarity with LLM techniques such as model fine-tuning, semantic search engines, etc.
Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks and cloud infrastructure (e.g. AWS).

Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

title: Business Intelligence Solutions Developer
description:
Join our team as a BI Solutions Developer, where you will play a key role in designing, developing, and supporting business intelligence and data solutions across the Firm. This role works across the BI lifecycle, including data transformation, data modeling, reporting, visualization, automation, and AI-enabled solutions.
You will work closely with business departments and technical teams to transform trusted enterprise data into intuitive, visually compelling solutions that tell a story with the data and make information easier to understand and use. Using Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and related technologies, you will support the Firm’s enterprise data strategy while promoting BI standards and enabling departments to develop effective solutions through citizen development.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Business Intelligence & Data Visualization
• Design and develop intuitive, visually compelling Power BI reports and dashboards that tell a story with the data, clearly communicate key insights, and support business decision-making.
• Translate business requirements and trusted enterprise data into practical BI solutions that make complex information easy to understand and use.
• Develop and maintain semantic models, DAX calculations, Power Query transformations, and reusable reporting components.
• Apply strong visual design, user experience, and attention to detail to create polished, consistent, and professional BI solutions.
• Maintain, modernize, optimize, and support new and existing reports, dashboards, semantic models, refresh processes, and data connections.
## Microsoft Fabric & Data Transformation
• Use Microsoft Fabric as the primary low-code platform for developing data transformation, integration, analytics, and BI solutions.
• Develop and maintain Dataflows Gen2 and related Fabric components to prepare, cleanse, combine, and transform enterprise data for reporting and analytics.
• Create downstream Fabric data solutions, including lakehouses and reusable transformations, using trusted data from the Firm’s Enterprise Data Model.
• Use Fabric pipelines, OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, and related capabilities as appropriate to develop scalable and maintainable BI solutions. Apply data quality and validation practices and identify transformations or business rules that should be transitioned to Data Engineering for implementation within the enterprise data layer.
Enterprise Data & Integration
• Use the Firm’s Enterprise Data Model as a primary source of trusted, consistent data for BI, analytics, AI, and reporting solutions.
• Maintain a strong working understanding of enterprise data architecture, including Azure Data Lake, data pipelines, integration, transformation, dimensional modeling, and related data engineering concepts.
• Collaborate closely with Data Engineers and application developers to understand enterprise data structures and define data requirements for BI and analytical solutions.
• Recognize when data requirements extend beyond the BI and low-code layer and work with Data Engineering to develop appropriate enterprise-level solutions.
• Integrate data from enterprise applications, databases, APIs, SharePoint, files, and other approved sources when required to support business solutions.
AI & Automation
• Develop and support AI-enabled BI and data solutions using Microsoft Fabric, Copilot, Data Agents, and related technologies.
• Develop and support data agents that allow users and business solutions to interact with trusted enterprise data through intuitive, AI-enabled experiences.
• Collaborate with Data Engineers, developers, and business teams to identify and prepare the data required for AI and agent-based solutions.
• Develop workflow and data automation solutions using Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Microsoft Fabric, and related low-code technologies.
• Evaluate emerging AI, automation, and Fabric capabilities and apply them where they can improve access to information, automate manual processes, or deliver greater business value.
BI Governance, Standards & Citizen Development
• Establish and promote standards and best practices for BI development, data modeling, visualization, transformation, security, performance, deployment, and support.
• Partner with Finance, Client Value, and other technically capable departments to enable effective citizen development of reports, dashboards, dataflows, automations, and other BI solutions.
• Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Power Query, DAX, visualization, data modeling, and other approved low-code technologies.
• Promote the use of trusted enterprise data, shared semantic models, reusable solutions, and consistent business definitions while reducing duplication of data and business logic.
• Review and support citizen-developed solutions to promote appropriate design, data quality, security, performance, maintainability, and alignment with enterprise standards.
REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS
Proficiency in the following tools, technologies, and concepts:
• Microsoft Power BI, including report and dashboard development, semantic models, Power BI Service, security, deployment, and data refresh.
• Microsoft Fabric, including Dataflows Gen2, Data Factory, pipelines, OneLake, Lakehouse, Warehouse, and related analytics capabilities.
• Power Query/M and DAX for data transformation, business calculations, KPIs, and semantic model development.
• Data modeling and transformation, including dimensional modeling, data integration, cleansing, validation, and data quality.
• SQL and relational database concepts for querying, validating, and working with enterprise data.
• Power Platform and automation technologies, including Power Automate and Azure Logic Apps.
• AI-enabled data solutions, including familiarity with Fabric Data Agents, Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, and related technologies.
• Working knowledge of Azure and data engineering concepts, including Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, data pipelines, REST APIs, enterprise data models, and modern data architectures.
REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, or a related field.
• Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience developing business intelligence, reporting, data, or related technology solutions.
• Demonstrated experience developing and supporting Power BI reports, dashboards, semantic models, and data transformation solutions.
• Experience translating business requirements into technical solutions and collaborating with both business stakeholders and technical teams.
• Experience supporting self-service BI, citizen development, or technically capable business teams is preferred; experience with legal industry data, terminology, or business processes is a plus.
REQUIRED INTERPERSONAL AND COMMUNICATION SKILLS
• Ability to build effective relationships and collaborate with business stakeholders, citizen developers, Data Engineers, application developers, and other technical teams.
• Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences and translate business needs into practical solutions.
• Ability to guide and mentor technically capable business users and citizen developers while promoting appropriate BI standards and best practices.
• Ability to lead discussions, provide technical recommendations, solve complex problems, and build consensus across business and technical teams.
• Ability to work independently, take ownership of solutions, and effectively manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
OTHER DESIRED TRAITS
• Strong attention to detail with a professional, business-focused approach and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.
• Proactive and able to identify opportunities to improve reporting, data processes, automation, and user experience.
• Collaborative and service-oriented, with the ability to balance business enablement with appropriate technology standards and governance.
• Curious and adaptable, with an interest in emerging BI, data, AI, and automation technologies and their practical application to business needs.
## TRAVEL REQUIREMENT
## Minimal.
OFF-HOURS SERVICE REQUIREMENT

description:
## About Centific
Centific is a frontier AI data foundry that curates diverse, high-quality data, using our purpose-built technology platforms to empower the Magnificent Seven and our enterprise clients with safe, scalable AI deployment. Our team includes more than 150 PhDs and data scientists, along with more than 4,000 AI practitioners and engineers. We harness the power of an integrated solution ecosystem—comprising industry-leading partnerships and 1.8 million vertical domain experts in more than 230 markets—to create contextual, multilingual, pre-trained datasets; fine-tuned, industry-specific LLMs; and RAG pipelines supported by vector databases. Our zero-distance innovation™ solutions for GenAI can reduce GenAI costs by up to 80% and bring solutions to market 50% faster.
Our mission is to bridge the gap between AI creators and industry leaders by bringing best practices in GenAI to unicorn innovators and enterprise customers. We aim to help these organizations unlock significant business value by deploying GenAI at scale, helping to ensure they stay at the forefront of technological advancement and maintain a competitive edge in their respective markets.
## About Job
AI Research Engineer: Vision AI / VLM / Physical AI
Company: Centific
Location: Seattle, WA (or Remote)
Type: Full‑time
Build the Future of Perception & Embodied Intelligence
Are you pushing the frontier of computer vision, multimodal large models, and embodied/physical AI—and have the publications to show it? Join us to translate cutting-edge‑ research into production systems that perceive, reason, and act in the real world.
## The Mission
We are building state of‑ t‑heart Vision AI across 2D/3D perception, egocentric/360° understanding, and multimodal reasoning. As an AI Research Engineer, you will own high‑ ‑leverage experiments from paper → prototype → deployable module in our platform.
We are seeking passionate Engineersto join our cutting-edge labs, you could be part of :
Computer Vision team as a Research Engineer and dive into the world of 3D reconstruction, scene understanding, and visual AI. You’ll explore innovative techniques like those used to transform real-world spaces into immersive 3D models—such as the 3D Reconstruction projects —and work with cutting-edge architectures like VGG-T (Visual Geometry Grounded Transformers), known for advancing deep learning in vision tasks. This role is perfect for those excited to develop AI systems that interpret, reconstruct, and interact with the visual world, using state-of-the-art tools and methodologies. Physical AI Robotics team, where you’ll work at the intersection of simulation, robotics, and AI. You’ll leverage NVIDIA’s Omniverse for advanced 3D simulation and collaboration, Isaac Sim for robotics training and testing, and GR00T for foundation models in robotics. Experience with Holoscan SDK for real-time medical and industrial robotics pipelines, Newton Physics for dynamic simulation, and NVIDIA’s NERD for neural robot dynamics will be a plus. This role is ideal for those eager to push the boundaries of AI-driven robotics using state-of-the-art tools and frameworks.
## What You’ll Do
Advance Visual Perception: Build and fine‑tune models for detection, tracking, segmentation (2D/3D), pose & activity recognition, and scene understanding (incl. 360° and multi‑view).
Multimodal Reasoning with VLMs: Train/evaluate vision–language models (VLMs) for grounding, dense captioning, temporal QA, and tooluse; design retrieval‑ augmented and agentic loops for perception‑ action‑ tasks.
Physical AI & Embodiment: Prototype perception‑in‑the‑loop policies that close the gap from pixels to actions (simulation + real data). Integrate with planners and task graphs for manipulation, navigation, or safety workflows.
Data & Evaluation at Scale: Curate datasets, author high‑signal evaluation protocols/KPIs, and run ablations that make results irreproducible impossible.
Systems & Deployment: Package research into reliable services on a modern stack (Kubernetes, Docker, Ray, FastAPI), with profiling, telemetry, and CI for reproducible science.
Agentic Workflows: Orchestrate multi-agent pipelines (e.g., ‑LangGraphstyle graphs) that combine perception, reasoning, simulation, and ‑codeg eneration to ‑selfc heck and ‑selfcorrect‑.
## Example Problems You Might Tackle
• Long horizon‑ video understanding (events, activities, causality) from egocentric or 360° video.
• 3D scene grounding: linking language queries to objects, affordances, and trajectories.
• Fast, privacy preserving perception for ‑ondevice‑ or edge inference.
• Robust multi‑modal evaluation: temporal consistency, open‑set detection, uncertainty.
• Vision conditioned‑ policy evaluation in sim (Isaac/MuJoCo) with sim2real stress tests.
## Minimum Qualifications
Masters/Ph.D in CS/EE/Robotics (or related), actively publishing in CV/ML/Robotics (e.g., CVPR/ICCV/ECCV, NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR, CoRL/RSS).
• Strong PyTorch (or JAX) and Python; comfort with CUDA profiling and mixed precision‑ training.
• Demonstrated research in computer vision and at least one of: VLMs (e.g., LLaVA style, video‑ language‑ models), embodied/physical AI, 3D perception.
• Proven ability to move from paper → code → ablation → result with rigorous experiment tracking.
## Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with video models (e.g., TimeSFormer/MViT/VideoMAE), diffusion or 3D GS/NeRF pipelines, or SLAM/scene reconstruction.
• Prior work on multimodal grounding (referring expressions, spatial language, affordances) or temporal reasoning.
• Familiarity with ROS2, DeepStream/TAO, or edge inference optimizations (TensorRT, ONNX).
• Scalable training: Ray, distributed data loaders, sharded checkpoints.
• Strong software craft: testing, linting, profiling, containers, and reproducibility.
• Public code artifacts (GitHub) and first‑author publications or strong open source‑ impact.
## Our Stack (you’ll touch a subset)
Modeling: PyTorch, torchvision/lightning, Hugging Face, OpenMMLab, xFormers
Perception: YOLO/Detectron/MMDet, SAM/Mask2Former, CLIP‑style backbones, optical flow
VLM / LLM: Vision encoders + LLMs, RAG for video, toolformer‑/agent loops
3D / Sim: Open3D, PyTorch3D, Isaac/MuJoCo, COLMAP/SLAM, NeRF/3DGS
Systems: Python, FastAPI, Ray, Kubernetes, Docker, Triton/TensorRT, Weights & Biases
Pipelines: LangGraph‑like orchestration, data versioning, artifact stores
## What Success Looks Like
• A publishable or open‑sourced outcome (with company approval) or a production‑ready module that measurably moves a product KPI (latency, accuracy, robustness).
• Clean, reproducible code with documented ablations and an evaluation report that a teammate can rerun end‑to‑end.
• A demo that clearly communicates capabilities, limits, and next steps.
## Why Centific
Real impact: Your research ships—powering core features in our MVPs and products.
Mentorship: Work closely with our Principal Architect and senior engineers/researchers.
Velocity + Rigor: We balance top‑tier research practices with pragmatic product focus.
## Salary: $90K Annually

At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
## Position Summary
Data Science interns will work to extract insight from complex clinical, translational and real-world data. They will have the opportunity to work on complex data science problems including modeling techniques to interpret, infer and recommend based on insights from data. The full-time internship will take place in the summer of 2027 (Jun – Aug 2027).
Key Responsibilities
-Formulates, implements, tests, and validates predictive models and implements efficient automated processes for producing modeling results at scale.
-Creates robust models based on statistical and data mining techniques to provide insights and recommendations based on large complex data sets.
-Presents stories told by data in a visually appealing and easy to understand manner.
Qualifications & Experience
-Currently in a quantitative sciences program ( Computer Science, Math, Computational Biology), and should not have graduated from the program before the end of internship (Aug 2027)
-Proven data driven problem solving capabilities using AI/ML approaches
-All candidates must be authorized to work in the US both at the time of hire and for the duration of their employment (Jun – Aug 2027).
• Please note that immigration or visa sponsorship is not available for this position
-Prior internship or FTE work experience in data science or biopharma spaces a plus
-Demonstrated passion for healthcare and/or biopharma
## Core Competencies
• Strong knowledge of programing languages, with a focus on machine learning (Python, Spark, R, Tensorflow, Sagemaker, etc.) with good knowledge of machine learning libraries (scikit in Python, mlr3 in r, etc.)
-Experience with longitudinal and real-world patient data analysis
-Experience with next generation sequencing (omics) translational data analysis
-Experience in using deep learning-based algorithms in one of the following areas - image analysis, clinical Natural Language Processing, omics data, clinical datasets
-Experience building foundation models for biopharma or clinical questions
-Experience in agentic code/API/app creation workflows using Claude, Copilot, etc.

title: Fullstack Software Engineer - Embedded Payments
description:
## About the opportunity
Join our Embedded Payments team as a Full Stack Software Engineer and make a real impact every day. We say that because we know that every conversation we have, every line of code we write, and every interface we design is another opportunity for us to elevate everyday life experiences for our customers and the people and communities they serve.
Reporting to the Software Engineering Manager, you'll help build and scale our cloud-native payment orchestration platform that processes significant transaction volume across multiple Xplor brands.
You are passionate about building scalable systems and great user experiences while maintaining software development best practices. You write code that is thoughtful end-to-end — from the API contract down to the database, and from the data model up through the UI. You're comfortable owning features across the stack and collaborating closely with backend, frontend, QA, and DevOps engineers to deliver high-quality software.
## Our Tech Stack
• Frontend: React (Vite), MUI, JavaScript
• Testing: Jest, ESLint, Prettier, Storybook, Playwright, K6
• Backend: Node.js, AWS (ECS, RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, API Gateway, Lambda, Cognito, SQS, EventBridge)
• DevOps: Bitbucket Pipelines, Terraform
• Payments: Worldpay, Stripe, Apple Pay / Google Pay
## Responsibilities & Duties
• Execute the full software development lifecycle across both backend services and frontend interfaces
• Design and build well-tested, well-documented features that span APIs, data models, and UI
• Produce technical specifications and assess operational feasibility for new payments features
• Integrate components into cohesive, production-ready systems with appropriate observability
• Contribute to verification plans, quality assurance procedures, and deployment guardrails
• Maintain and improve existing functionality, including documentation
• Participate in deployment planning, on-call rotations, and incident response as part of running a payments platform
• Use AI-assisted development tools effectively to improve velocity without compromising quality
• Stay current with platform updates, security practices, and PCI compliance requirements
## What would make you a good candidate?
We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big-picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do.
## You'll need:
• 4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a Computer Science/Engineering degree or equivalent
• Strong Node.js experience and demonstrated ability to ship production backend services
• Experience building React-based frontends that consume RESTful APIs
• Experience designing and building RESTful APIs and microservices
• Working knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and clear understanding of separation of concerns in service design
• Hands-on experience with AWS or a comparable cloud platform
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, or similar)
• Proficiency with Git, agile delivery (Scrum preferred), and testing frameworks like Jest
• Fluency with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) and an articulate point of view on where they help and where they don't
• Comfortable working on a 100% remote team and able to operate independently within an agile group
## It would be great if you also have:
• Experience building or operating payments systems — payment orchestration, tokenization, acquirer integrations (Worldpay, Stripe, Adyen, Finix, Basis Theory), or PCI-compliant environments
• Familiarity with event-driven architectures (SQS, EventBridge, Kafka)
• Exposure to observability tooling (SigNoz, Grafana, Datadog, etc.)
• Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform)
At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you do not tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.
The average base salary pay range for this position is $95,000 to $105,000
Fully remote option, U.S.-based (excluding Hawaii and Alaska). Preference for candidates in the Kansas City region
## Values and Life at Xplor
Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:
• Find a better way
• Do the right thing
• Say it straight
• Win together
• Own the outcome
If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.
As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed.
## Some of our perks and benefits are:
• Paid Parental Leave benefit programs
• #GiveBackDays/Commitment to social impact – 3 extra days off to volunteer and give back to your local community
• Ongoing dedication to Diversity & Inclusion initiatives such as D&I Council, Global Mentorship Program
• Access to free mental health support
• Flexible working arrangements
## Ready to apply?
To start your application, please submit your resume, and we will be in touch as soon as we can. Please include the word "moonshot" at the top of your message to the Hiring Manager so that we know you took the time to read our job ad.
## Before you apply
To be considered for employment, you must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is advertised. This applies to remote roles too. Xplor does not sponsor visas, either at the time of hire or at any later time. We're also not able to offer contractor arrangements or Employer of Record engagements for this position at this stage.
Please apply through our careers portal or external job boards only. We're unable to upload emailed applications, as our process requires you to answer screening questions directly.
We also invite you to check out our Candidate FAQs for more information about our recruitment process .
## Interview Recording and Background Checks
As part of our hiring process, successful candidates will be asked to complete background and identity verification checks. Many of our roles are remote, and to protect both candidates and our business from recruitment fraud, we may record video interviews during the process. We keep any recordings and related data only for as long as the hiring process is active and do not retain them afterwards.
## EEO and Artificial Intelligence
We believe in transparent hiring. We use an applicant tracking system with artificial intelligence-enabled features to support our recruitment process, but our recruitment team makes all hiring decisions after human review. We do not rely on artificial intelligence to make final hiring decisions. Find our Candidate AI Usage guidelines here.
Xplor is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We're dedicated to attracting, retaining and developing our people regardless of gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status and age. We encourage applications from all sectors of the community. All Information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Xplor is committed to fully including all qualified individuals. In keeping with our commitment, Xplor will take steps to ensure people with disabilities receive reasonable accommodations. Accordingly, if reasonable accommodation is required to fully participate in the job application or interview process, to perform the essential functions of the position, and/or to receive all other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact us via .
We make it a priority to respond to every applicant.
Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership-based and service-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences.
