title: AI Engineer / AI Automation Specialist
description:
## AI Engineer / AI Automation Specialist – LLMs, AI Agents & Workflow Automation | Remote
Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
## About the Role
At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an AI Engineer / AI Automation Specialist to build AI-powered applications, intelligent agents, integrations, and business automations.
This is a hands-on technical role for someone who can take an AI or automation use case from idea to working implementation. You’ll combine software development, LLMs, APIs, automation platforms, and agentic workflows to build systems that reduce manual work and improve business efficiency.
You’ll work across generative AI, AI agents, API integrations, workflow automation, prompt engineering, and internal tooling, while continuously evaluating emerging AI technologies.
## What You’ll Own
## AI Applications & Agent Development
• Design and build AI-powered applications and workflows
• Develop AI agents that can execute structured tasks and business processes
• Build agentic workflows using LLMs, tools, APIs, and business logic
• Turn manual processes into scalable AI-assisted systems
• Improve existing AI applications as business requirements evolve
## LLM & Generative AI Integration
• Integrate LLMs with internal systems and third-party platforms
• Build structured workflows around generative AI models
• Develop and refine prompts, tools, and reusable AI components
• Implement reliable structured outputs and workflow logic
• Evaluate AI responses for quality, consistency, and reliability
## Automation & Business Workflows
• Build automated workflows that reduce repetitive manual work
• Connect applications and business systems using APIs and automation platforms
• Develop workflows using tools such as Make, Zapier, n8n, or similar platforms
• Troubleshoot failed or unreliable automations
• Continuously improve workflow efficiency and scalability
## APIs & Integrations
• Build and maintain API integrations between AI systems and external platforms
• Work with webhooks and third-party services
• Manage data flows between applications and automation workflows
• Troubleshoot integration issues and improve system reliability
## Development & Internal Tools
• Build internal tools that improve team productivity and operational efficiency
• Develop technical solutions using Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
• Write clean, maintainable code for AI and automation systems
• Use modern AI coding tools to accelerate development and debugging
• Support deployment and ongoing maintenance of AI-powered solutions
## AI Quality, Testing & Reliability
• Evaluate AI output quality and reliability
• Test prompts, workflows, agents, and integrations
• Identify edge cases and failure points
• Improve AI systems based on real-world performance
• Build appropriate safeguards and validation into automated workflows
## Research & Experimentation
• Research and test emerging AI technologies
• Evaluate new LLMs, agent frameworks, AI coding tools, and automation platforms
• Identify practical opportunities to apply new technologies
• Recommend improvements based on testing and business impact
## Documentation & Process Development
• Document AI systems, workflows, integrations, and processes
• Create clear technical documentation for ongoing maintenance
• Maintain organized records of automation logic and system dependencies
• Build repeatable processes that allow successful solutions to scale
## Requirements
• Professional experience in software development, automation, AI, or a related technical role
• Hands-on experience working with LLMs and generative AI
• Experience building AI-powered applications, workflows, or automations
• Experience integrating APIs and third-party platforms
• Programming experience, preferably with Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
• Familiarity with AI coding tools and agentic development workflows
• Understanding of prompt development and structured AI workflows
• Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
• Ability to independently take projects from concept through implementation
• Strong written and spoken English
• Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
## Nice to Have
• Experience with Make, Zapier, n8n, or similar automation platforms
• Experience building AI agents or multi-step agentic workflows
• Familiarity with webhooks and event-driven integrations
• Experience developing internal business tools
• Experience working with structured LLM outputs and tool/function calling
• Familiarity with cloud deployment and modern development workflows
• Experience evaluating and monitoring AI system performance
## Tools & Technologies
LLMs & Generative AI | Python | JavaScript/TypeScript | APIs | Webhooks | Make | Zapier | n8n | AI Coding Tools | Agentic Workflows | Automation Platforms
## What Makes You a Strong Fit
You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:
• Build with AI rather than simply use AI for basic productivity
• Enjoy turning manual workflows into automated systems
• Can move from an idea to a functional technical solution independently
• Understand both software development and business automation
• Experiment with new AI tools and technologies regularly
• Think critically about AI reliability rather than assuming outputs are correct
• Are comfortable troubleshooting across APIs, code, and automation platforms
• Prioritize practical business impact over experimentation for its own sake
## What a Typical Day Looks Like
Your day may include building an AI agent, connecting an LLM to a business platform through an API, developing an automation in n8n or Make, troubleshooting an existing workflow, or creating an internal tool that eliminates repetitive work.
You may also test prompts and agent behavior, evaluate AI output quality, document systems, and research emerging AI technologies that could improve existing workflows.
In short: you turn AI capabilities into practical, reliable systems that automate work and improve business operations.
## Key Metrics for Success
• AI workflows successfully deployed into real business processes
• Reduction in repetitive manual work
• Reliability and accuracy of AI-powered systems
• Successful API and third-party integrations
• Speed from idea to working implementation
• Automation uptime and workflow reliability
• Quality and maintainability of technical documentation
• Measurable operational efficiency created through AI
## Interview Process
• Initial Application
• Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
• Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
• Technical / AI Automation Interview
• Client Interview
• Offer & Onboarding
## Spark Hire Video Interview – Required
As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.
After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.
Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.
## Apply Now
If you have hands-on experience with LLMs, AI agents, workflow automation, APIs, and software development and enjoy turning business problems into working AI-powered systems, we’d love to hear from you.
Apply today and help build practical AI systems that automate work and improve how businesses operate.

Information Technology Services at Rosalind Franklin University of Medicine invites applications for a full-time Application Developer & Analyst III. This role bridges core ERP functionality (Ellucian Colleague) and other applications with modern platforms, systems, and automated solutions.
Our generous benefits package includes medical, dental, and vision plans; paid parental leave; short term and long term disability plans; life insurance; flexible spending accounts; and a 403(b) retirement plan which includes a 8% employer contribution after 2 years of service. RFUMS is committed to employee wellbeing and work-life balance. Full time staff are eligible for 3 weeks of vacation, 15 sick days, and 9 paid holidays plus two floating holidays.
This position may be eligible for a remote work arrangement.

RFUMS is a graduate health sciences university dedicated to improving the wellness of all people through interprofessional education, scientific discovery, and the application of knowledge. Through collaboration, innovation, and scholarship, RFUMS prepares future healthcare professionals and advances research to improve human health.
ITS supports the university's academic, research, and administrative operations by providing reliable, secure, and innovative technology solutions. Our department brings together teams of skilled professionals who share a commitment to technical excellence, responsive service, and collaboration. Together, we work to advance the university's mission while empowering students, faculty, and staff to make effective use of technology.

Colleague Integration Architecture & API Management:Design, build, test, and maintain real-time and batch API integrations (REST/SOAP, Colleague API, Ethos) between core administrative systems (Ellucian Colleague).
Enterprise ERP Support & Development:Oversee and enhance Ellucian Colleague ERP functionality, including Colleague Web API, Self-Service, patch management, cloning, and database structures in collaboration with DBAs.
Software Design & Custom Application Building:Model, construct, deploy, and debug complex applications and custom user interfaces across multiple frameworks (SQL, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Envision/Unidata).
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Technical Leadership:Work alongside the Senior Application Developer or independently to gather requirements from institutional stakeholders, document system architectures, lead project execution, and mentor junior developers on technical best practices.
Operations & Security:
• Perform enhancements to existing software applications across multiple platforms to meet the changing needs of the University
• Manage and enhance Colleague security to safeguard sensitive institutional data.
Operational Tier Support:Troubleshoot and resolve escalated application and integration issues logged through the University's ticketing system.

• Must achieve satisfactory results from a background check.
## Required Education & Experience
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
Experience: 6+ years of enterprise software development and application support experience. Proficiency with a variety of programming languages and frameworks, including Envision Basic, Python, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and an understanding of APIs.

ERP Expertise: 6+ years of demonstrated experience with Ellucian Colleague Products (UI, Self-Service, Colleague Studio, SA Valet, Ethos, etc).
Database & APIs: Demonstrated knowledge in database SQL programming, REST/SOAP APIs, and integration middleware.
• Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and cross-functional communication skills.

• 8+ years of direct experience working in a higher education environment.
• 8+ years of hands-on experience developing, customizing, and supporting Ellucian Colleague ERP systems.
• Experience with the Ellucian Ethos API Integration Platform.

AI Platform Architect, Strategy and Enablement
description:
## Job Description
At EisnerAmper, we look for individuals who welcome new ideas, encourage innovation, and are eager to make an impact. Whether you’re starting out in your career or taking your next step as a seasoned professional, the EisnerAmper experience is one-of-a-kind. You can design a career you’ll love from top to bottom – we give you the tools you need to succeed and the autonomy to reach your goals.
EisnerAmper is seeking an AI Platform Architect, Strategy & Enablement who will serve as the technical backbone of EisnerAmper’s AI transformation, owning the performance, reliability, and cost-efficiency of the EisnerAI Platform. This role will own and execute AI Platform strategy, defining the multi-year roadmap, cross-service-line capability, and coherence that position the platform as a strategic asset, scaling to 1,000 deployed AI agents across every solution, from intelligent tax preparation to agentic audit workflows. The role will build model lifecycle, evaluation, and multi-vendor orchestration as usage expands across every team.
Reporting to the Chief AI Officer, this is a high-impact, high-visibility role at the intersection of platform architecture, AI engineering, and strategic operations. The critical dimensions of this position are internal - elevating platform fluency and technical depth across teams and external — cultivating strategic partnerships across the hyperscaler and AI vendor ecosystem to extend platform capability into wide ecosystem integration opportunities.
## What it Means to Work for EisnerAmper:
You will get to be part of one of the largest and fastest growing accounting and advisory firms in the industry
You will have the flexibility to manage your days in support of our commitment to work/life balance
You will join a culture that has received multiple top “Places to Work” awards
We believe that great work is accomplished when cultures, ideas and experiences come together to create innovative solutions
We understand that embracing our differences is what unites us as a team and strengthens our foundation
Showing up authentically is how we, both as professionals and a Firm, find inspiration to do our best work
## What Work You Will be Responsible For:
## Own and Execute AI Platform Strategy
Own the multi-year platform roadmap — architecture, model lifecycle, and governance-as-code — scaling the EisnerAI Platform on Azure toward 1,000+ deployed agents while ensuring Tax, Audit, Advisory, and Outsourcing build on one coherent foundation.
Define and enforce model lifecycle standards (active, legacy, deprecated, retired) and evaluation benchmarks across the firm's multi-LLM environment, turning vendor and model choices — GPT-4o, o3, and what comes next, into a deliberate portfolio strategy rather than ad hoc adoption.
Own the connection between the EisnerAI Platform and the firm's broader technology ecosystem (ETI), establishing this bridge proactively rather than retrofitting it once scale makes it expensive.
Ensure the platform roadmap and standards account for both B2B and B2C dimensions of the firm's AI use — firmwide client service delivery as well as direct-to-client and wealth management contexts.
## Lead Platform Strategy and Architecture
Architect and evolve the platform's core data, application, and agentic layers on Azure AI Foundry, establishing the reference architecture and technical standards that govern how every solution from intelligent tax preparation to agentic audit workflows gets built.
Codify AI and data governance (NIST AI RMF, PCAOB, Section 7216, and emerging requirements including the EU AI Act) into enforceable platform-level controls and automated compliance checks, in partnership with the firm's existing AI governance function.
Lead AI performance engineering across the firm's LLM ecosystem, benchmarking models for accuracy, latency, cost, and quality, and directing routing and optimization strategy to continuously lower cost-per-agent without sacrificing output quality.
## Build and Operate Cross-Cutting Capability Enablement
Build and operate the platform's real-time performance monitoring layer, hallucination rates, retrieval precision, adoption, and cost-per-interaction, as a shared capability every service line draws on rather than one each team rebuilds independently.
Own identity, access, and security controls for AI systems and agents firmwide, establishing the guardrails that let Tax, Audit, Advisory, and Outsourcing scale their own use cases safely on shared infrastructure.
Deliver executive and board-level dashboards translating platform performance, adoption, and cost into business value narratives, and mentor technical and business teams across IT, AI Advisory, and service lines to build platform fluency firmwide.
## Basic Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or related technical field
10+ years of experience in technology strategy, enterprise architecture, or platform/product leadership including experience as a Chief Architect or Enterprise Solutions Architect with a demonstrated record of scaling platforms across multiple business units
5+ years architecting enterprise-scale solutions on Microsoft Azure including AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Cosmos DB, ADLS, Purview, and AI Search with direct accountability for platform reliability and cost at production scale
3+ years leading LLM benchmarking, evaluation, and optimization programs in production environments, with a track record of translating model performance data into platform-wide selection and routing strategy
## Preferred or Desired Qualifications
Master's degree preferred (Computer Science, AI/ML, Cloud Architecture, or MBA with technical focus)
Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure AI Engineer Associate, or equivalent certifications strongly preferred
Data Platforms: ADLS Gen2, Cosmos DB, Azure SQL, Azure Synapse/Databricks for analytics and data engineering
AI Search & RAG: Vector search, semantic ranking, knowledge mining, and retrieval pipeline optimization
Governance & Compliance Tooling: Microsoft Purview, Azure Policy, data lineage, and audit logging frameworks
Monitoring & Observability: Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Log Analytics, custom dashboards (Power BI, Grafana)
Programming Languages: Python, C#, TypeScript, SQL, Bicep/Terraform
DevOps & MLOps: Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipeline design
Cost Management: Azure Cost Management, FinOps practices, token-level cost tracking and optimization
Proven track record of designing and implementing data governance frameworks and compliance controls at enterprise scale
Experience managing cloud cost optimization initiatives with demonstrated savings outcomes
Demonstrated experience mentoring technical and non-technical teams across organizational boundaries, and experience owning vendor or model portfolio strategy in a multi-LLM environment
Experience establishing or scaling a platform roadmap and adoption model from an engineering-first starting point
Track record of leading through ambiguous, rapidly evolving technology landscapes
Strong stakeholder management across engineering, governance, and business-line functions
Demonstrated experience translating governance, risk, or compliance requirements into platform-level controls or operational practice
Applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa for this position now or in the future.
EisnerAmper is proud to be a merit-based employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of veteran or disability status or any protected characteristics under federal, state, or local law.
## About EisnerAmper:
EisnerAmper is one of the largest accounting, tax, and business advisory firms, with approximately 450 partners and 4,500 employees across the world. We combine responsiveness with a long-range perspective; to help clients meet the pressing issues they face today and position them for success tomorrow.
Our clients represent enterprises of every form, ranging from sophisticated financial institutions to startups, global public firms to middle-market companies, governmental entities as well as high-net-worth individuals, family offices, nonprofit organizations and entrepreneurial ventures across a variety of industries. We are also engaged by the attorneys, financial professionals, bankers, investors, and key stakeholders who serve these clients.

title: AI/ML Device Modeling Engineer (2027 New College Graduate)
description:
## About GlobalFoundries
GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power‑efficient and high‑performance solutions for high‑growth markets. GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit .
## New College Graduates Overview:
We offer many full-time employment paths for recent graduates, which provide accelerated training in a fast-paced work environment, cross-functional working opportunities, and talent mobility. New college graduates are provided with mentorship, networking, and leadership opportunities, which give our new team members life-long connections and skills.​
## Summary of Role:
GlobalFoundries is seeking a new college graduate with strong artificial intelligence and machine-learning skills to develop AI-enabled methods for semiconductor device modeling. The engineer will combine device physics, measured silicon data, simulation data, and modern AI/ML techniques to accelerate model extraction, improve predictive accuracy, and create scalable modeling workflows for CMOS, cryogenic, photonic, superconducting, and other emerging devices.
## Essential Responsibilities include:
• Develop and evaluate machine-learning methods for semiconductor device modeling, including parameter extraction, surrogate modeling, model calibration, and prediction of device characteristics.
• Build reproducible data pipelines that combine measured device data, compact-model simulations, TCAD results, and relevant process or test metadata.
• Train, validate, and compare AI/ML models using appropriate baselines, holdout datasets, error metrics, uncertainty analysis, and physics-based constraints.
• Apply methods such as neural networks, Gaussian processes, optimization, sensitivity analysis, and physics-informed machine learning to device-modeling problems.
• Automate model fitting, feature extraction, hyperparameter optimization, regression testing, visualization, and reporting using Python-based workflows.
• Work with device, characterization, compact-modeling, PDK, EDA, and circuit-design teams to translate technical requirements into usable AI-enabled modeling solutions.
• Document datasets, assumptions, model architecture, training methods, validation results, limitations, and recommended usage to support traceability and knowledge transfer.
• Contribute to proof-of-concept demonstrations and transition successful methods into maintainable device-modeling and design-enablement workflows.
## Other Responsibilities:
• Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs.
## Required Qualifications:
• Education – Graduating with Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Physics, Physicss or related field from an accredited degree program.
• Must have at least an overall 3.0 GPA and proven good academic standing.
• Language Fluency - English (Written & Verbal)
• Academic or project experience in machine learning, deep learning, statistical modeling, optimization, or scientific data analysis.
• Strong Python programming skills and experience with common scientific and machine-learning libraries such as NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.
• Understanding of supervised learning, regression, neural networks, model validation, overfitting, uncertainty, and quantitative performance evaluation.
• Foundational understanding of semiconductor device physics and transistor electrical behavior, with interest in applying AI methods to device modeling.
• Experience working with structured scientific or engineering datasets, including data preparation, visualization, feature engineering, and reproducible analysis.
• Ability to communicate technical results clearly and collaborate across AI, device, modeling, characterization, and design teams.
• Travel - Up to 10%
## Preferred Qualifications:
• Prior related internship or co-op experience.
• Demonstrated prior leadership experience in the workplace, school projects, competitions, etc.
• Strong interest in leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support effective decision-making.
• Project management skills, i.e. the ability to innovate and execute solutions that matter; the ability to navigate ambiguity.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Strong planning & organizational skills
• Graduate coursework, thesis research, internship, co-op, or substantial project work in AI/ML for semiconductor devices, electronic design automation, scientific machine learning, or computational physics.
• Experience with physics-informed neural networks, differentiable programming, Bayesian optimization, Gaussian processes, active learning, or uncertainty quantification.
• Exposure to compact transistor models, SPICE simulation, parameter extraction, TCAD, cryogenic device behavior, photonic devices, superconducting devices, or quantum hardware.
• Experience using experiment tracking, version control, testing, or reproducibility tools such as Git, MLflow, Weights & Biases, containers, or automated workflows.
• Experience with Linux environments, high-performance computing, GPU acceleration, cloud computing, or large-scale simulation and training datasets.
• Ability to balance predictive performance with physical consistency, interpretability, robustness, and computational efficiency.
• Demonstrated technical initiative through publications, conference presentations, open-source contributions, competitions, or interdisciplinary research projects.

description:
## Salesforce Developer II
## About Us - CloudMasonry
CloudMasonry is a full-service Salesforce consultancy with multi-cloud expertise, serving enterprise clients through onshore, collaborative teams. Senior consultants shape the solution, and we were the first Salesforce consultancy to build AI into a complete delivery methodology that keeps requirements, documentation, and reporting moving so our teams spend more time with clients.
With offices in the US and UK, 65+ consultants holding 350+ Salesforce certifications, 559+ completed projects, a 4.9 CSAT, and an 89% repeat-client rate, CloudMasonry works with enterprise clients on their most complex Salesforce programs.
## About the Role
A Salesforce Developer II at CloudMasonry is a mid-level, technical consulting role for developers with Salesforce experience who can work independently and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical team members. A Developer II is responsible for delivering robust custom solutions on the Salesforce platform, carrying their work through the standard development lifecycle. A Developer II is familiar with common solution patterns, works with more senior resources on more advanced problems, and is a self-motivated learner of new technologies and related skills. Previous hands-on Salesforce experience and Salesforce technical certifications are required.
## Key Responsibilities
Build and deliver solutions with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and Flow, preferring configuration and using custom code where it is the better long-term answer
Work with the project team to take solutions from requirements through design, build, test, and deployment
Apply established solutions to common problems, and work with more senior resources to solve more advanced ones
Build integrations using APIs, events, and middleware (ETL and iPaaS) tools
Work in Git-based source control with Salesforce DX and CI/CD (continuous integration and delivery), and write well-structured Apex unit tests
Participate in code reviews and make sure development follows Salesforce best practices and CloudMasonry standards
Support UAT (user acceptance testing), troubleshoot defects, and communicate status, obstacles, and blockers to the project team
Help translate client requirements into technical tasks and communicate effectively with clients
## Provide effort estimates for their own work
Collaborate with the consulting project team to achieve client success
## Maintain the certifications required for the role
This role may require 25-50% travel time, depending on project needs. Therefore, we're seeking candidates who are open to and able to accommodate this level of travel.
## Ideal Candidate Profile
1-4 years of hands-on Salesforce development, ideally including time in a consulting environment or comparable experience working with business stakeholders or end users
Working experience with Apex, LWC, and Flow, and a developing sense of when to use configuration and when to write code
Understanding of platform limits, including governor limits, bulkification, and basic asynchronous processing (Batch, Queueable)
A solid foundation in object-oriented programming (Apex, Java, Python, or similar), JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, plus working knowledge of relational databases and SQL
Experience with REST and SOAP APIs and common integration patterns
Hands-on experience with Git, and familiarity with Salesforce DX and CI/CD
## Experience working in Agile or Scrum teams
Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Required certification: Salesforce Platform Developer I
Preferred certifications: Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder, JavaScript Developer I
## Benefits & Perks
## Full-time position with a competitive salary
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
401(k) plan: Company matches 50% of up to 4% of an Employee’s Contributions
## Unlimited PTO to maintain work-life balance
## Parental leave for new parents
## Paid company holidays
## Salesforce certification reimbursement
## Performance-based bonus eligibility
## Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion
At CloudMasonry, diverse perspectives drive innovation. We embrace candidates from all backgrounds and experiences to build a stronger, more inclusive team. You will find your place with us if you are passionate about problem-solving and collaboration.
## Application Process
After submitting your resume, you will receive an email invitation to complete an applicant assessment. This assessment helps us align your skills and attributes with the role. Candidates who do not complete the assessment will not be considered for the position.
Join CloudMasonry and take your Salesforce consulting career to the next level!
We participate in E-Verify, a federal program used to confirm employment eligibility and authorization to work in the United States.

title: Android Software Engineer
description:
## About BJAK
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
## The Role
We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for BJAK's Android Software Engineer.
This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.
## What You'll Own
Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.
Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.
Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.
Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.
Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.
Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.
Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.
## What We're Looking For
3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.
Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.
Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.
Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.
Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.
Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.
App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.
## Tech Stack
Kotlin
Jetpack Compose
Android SDK
Coroutines & Flow
SQL / NoSQL
TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)
## The Kind of Builder We Want
Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.
Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.
Moves fast without creating messy code.
Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.
Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.
## This Role Is Not For
Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.
Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.
People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.
Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.
People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.
## Location
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.
## Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
## Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:
1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Role-specific interview
3. CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Data Scientist - Product Analytics
description:
## About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.
We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
## How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.
## What we offer
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
About the role
We're looking for a Data Scientist - Product Analytics to join our Growth Data team. You'll own the analysis behind how people discover, adopt and stick with ElevenLabs' products, partnering closely with Product, Growth and the central Data team's certified metrics layer.
Define and own product health metrics: activation, feature adoption, retention and engagement across ElevenCreative, ElevenAgents and ElevenAPI.
Design, analyse and communicate the results of product experiments (A/B tests, feature launches, onboarding changes).
Partner with Analytics Engineering on the certified product KPI layer in dbt, and with Product on turning ambiguous questions into trusted analysis.
Work alongside fellow Growth data scientists on marketing- and revenue-adjacent questions that touch the product funnel.
Requirements
Demonstrated experience as a data scientist embedded with a product or growth team, ideally at a product-led company.
Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience in experimentation (A/B testing) and product analytics.
Ability to translate ambiguous product questions into clear, reusable analysis and defensible metrics.
Comfort working directly with Product and Growth stakeholders, and pushing back on ill-defined asks.
Structured thinker who can move fast without sacrificing rigour.
Bonus
Experience with activation / retention modelling or lifecycle analytics at a consumer or prosumer product.
Experience with dbt or a modern warehouse, partnering directly with analytics engineers.
Experience using AI tools or agents to speed up analysis or enable self-serve data access.
Growth potential
We believe in hiring the best talent in the world to make an impact in the right role at the right time. At ElevenLabs, strong performance creates opportunities for growth. Here are some of the career paths you can expect after excelling in this role:
Grow into a Senior or Staff Product Data Scientist role as the Growth Data team scales.
Expand scope across additional product lines (ElevenAgents, ElevenAPI).
Path into a Growth Data Science lead or broader data leadership track.
## Location
This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe, with the ability to operate in GMT and GMT+1 timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Warsaw.

title: Developer Support Engineer
description:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.
We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $18B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.
We're a remote-first team of 180+ people across 30+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.
This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.
## The Role
We’re looking for a Developer Support Engineer to help developers get the most out of RevenueCat, from their first integration to their next pricing experiment. You’ll work directly with customers every day, on anything from a quick question to a deep investigation in their apps, and every problem you solve gets a developer back to shipping and earning. You’ll also work with Engineering and Product, turning what you learn into better docs, clearer bug reports and a better product for every developer on RevenueCat.
## About you:
You have 3+ years of experience in an engineering or technical role.
You have experience integrating and shipping RevenueCat in a mobile app.
You have an understanding of the mobile development and release process.
You have experience in either iOS (Swift / Objective-C) or Android (Java / Kotlin)
You have great debugging skills: You will be identifying why apps aren’t working, often with limited information.
You have experience debugging code issues utilizing stack traces.
You have an interest in "wearing many hats," doing what it takes to help developers every day.
You have excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills: You will be writing to, presenting to and speaking with developers and colleagues daily.
You have empathy for developers and their development/learning process: we usually hear from developers at their lowest and need to be understanding.
You have a demonstrated creative problem-solving approach and strong analytical skills.
## In the first month, you'll:
Learn the common frustrations our customers have, and help them get unblocked to ship their apps
Learn the internal tools and processes used by the support team
Make improvements to our docs and support articles based on customer interactions to reduce support
Work with our engineering team to untangle complex tickets
## Within the first 3 months, you'll:
Make product suggestions that will improve the developer experience and reduce support
Build internal apps to test and reproduce issues
Work directly with customers to assist with onboarding and solution engineering
## Within the first 6 months, you'll:
Identify key problem areas for developers and make targeted improvements that help developers
Improve and create internal tools and dashboards for support and other internal processes
Make significant contributions to the support process that helps you and your teammates be more efficient
## Within the first 12 months, you'll:
Develop a super-hero like intuition for the root causes of tickets and become an expert troubleshooter
Interview, hire and mentor additional support engineers
Discover new and unexpected ways to delight developers with our support experience
## What we offer:
Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator
10-year window to exercise vested equity options
A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility
4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually
Paid desk at a co-working space
Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? title: Backend Engineer (Ruby), Plan: Spec-Driven Development
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
## An overview of this role
As a Backend Engineer on the Plan: Spec-Driven Development team, you'll help build GitLab's intent-to-code loop: agentic workflows that turn a stated intent into a refined work item, an implementation plan, and verified, mergeable code. You'll own early-stage backend work across the flows, application programming interfaces, data models, and evaluation systems behind this experience, using Ruby on Rails, Python, PostgreSQL, GitLab Duo Agent Platform, large language model application programming interfaces, and an artificial intelligence gateway.
You'll join a small, distributed team working on one of GitLab's highest-visibility product bets, collaborating with design partners toward a public beta. In your first year, you'll lead major features from an unclear problem through release, help shape scope with product and users, mentor other engineers, and influence technical decisions across agent workflows and evaluation methods.
## What you’ll do
• Lead backend features from early product discussions through technical design, implementation, rollout, and post-launch learning.
• Build the flows, application programming interfaces, and data models behind agent-generated work items, implementation plans, durable specifications, and mergeable code.
• Develop evaluation and benchmarking systems that measure workflow quality, token cost, and success rate.
• Use Ruby on Rails and Python to build reliable production systems, with PostgreSQL, GraphQL, representational state transfer, GitLab Duo Agent Platform, large language model application programming interfaces, and an artificial intelligence gateway.
• Collaborate directly with product, design, engineers, design partners, and users to shape scope and make practical trade-offs.
• Coordinate multi-person projects across the team and communicate decisions clearly in GitLab's asynchronous, all-remote environment.
• Mentor other engineers and contribute to technical direction across the Plan group and related artificial intelligence initiatives.
• Work in short iterations, share progress through demos, and use results and user feedback to guide what comes next.
## What you’ll bring
• Strong Ruby on Rails experience in a large production codebase and production experience with Python.
• Experience driving substantial projects with several engineers over multiple months, with clear user or business outcomes.
• A product mindset and experience owning features end to end, including shaping scope, making trade-offs, engaging with users, and learning from adoption after launch.
• A full stack background with a current focus on backend engineering, plus the ability to read modern frontend code and design effective APIs.
• Strong application programming interface design and structured query language fundamentals.
• Experience exploring artificial intelligence-assisted development.
• The ability to work independently, collaborate across functions and regions, and support others through technical leadership and mentoring. Experience with GraphQL, PostgreSQL performance at scale, or building and evaluating large language model or agent systems is helpful but not required.
We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and transferable experience. If you're excited about the role but don't meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply.
## About the team
We are a team of four engineers, with two backend and two frontend engineers across Canada and Europe. You'll work in an all-remote, async-first environment with weekly sync calls, retrospectives, demos, and short iterations. This is early-stage work with broad ownership, space for creativity, and a fast pace. For more about our team and its work, see Plan Team Handbook Page and Spec-Driven Development Initiative

Deeply obsessed with AI

description:
## Software Engineer, Application Integration
In Brief
We're a rapidly growing startup on a mission to make healthcare proactive by empowering physicians, nurses, and care team members with real-time data to save lives.
Join us in transforming healthcare from reactive to proactive. You’ll spearhead the engineering effort to build the bridge between massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems and the Bayesian platform, delivering critical, real-time insights to help clinicians save lives.
## Who We Are
Bayesian Health’s mission is to improve patient outcomes by empowering clinicians with the insights they need to make the right decision for the right patient at the point-of-care. We’re a diverse team of clinicians, engineers, machine learning experts, product designers, and performance improvement leaders committed to enabling smarter, patient-specific care delivery through unlocking the power of data.
We’re funded by top tier tech and biotech investors: Obvious Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, American Medical Association’s venture arm, Catalio Partners, and LifeForce Capital. Our company has won many awards; most recent recognitions include: Forbes AI Top 50, World Economic Forum Tech Pioneer, Time Best Inventions, BioTech AI Company of the Year.
Read more about our recent publication in Nature Medicine that associates our products with lives saved.
## What you’ll do
You will be at the forefront of a high-impact engineering mission, building the bridge between the Bayesian platform and the clinical workflows inside massive, complex Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems, delivering the real-time lifesaving insights that clinicians rely on. Working directly with our health system clients' EHR and clinical informatics teams, you'll bring our clinical insights to the point of care — in the right workflow, at the right moment — empowering care teams to make the best decisions for their patients.
Each integration is a partnership. An Implementation Lead owns the client relationship and project management; a Clinical Integration owns clinical workflow design and training. You own the technical workstream — which means you're the engineer in the room. When a clinician says the alert didn't fire for a patient, you have thirty minutes and their full attention to trace it from the EHR launch context through the API to the underlying data, and tell them what happened.
Responsibilities
Clinical Workflow Integration: Extend and configure the full-stack application across the EHR integration surface, coordinating with client EHR and clinical informatics teams, to deliver Bayesian's clinical insights to clinicians.
Integration Testing & Troubleshooting: Implement automated integration tests and work directly with client technical teams and frontline clinicians during integration testing to investigate and resolve issues, ensuring smooth and timely integrations.
Production Deployment & Go-Live: Execute the deployment process in close collaboration with the client's technical team, ensuring all configurations and builds for the application and workflow are successfully promoted to production for a seamless launch. During go-live week, you will serve as the technical point of contact for any application integration issues, both internally and with the client's teams, providing clear status updates to cross-functional partners so they can effectively manage client communication.
Integration Tooling & Automation: Develop frameworks and tooling, leveraging LLMs and automation, to increase the efficiency and velocity of our platform integrations as we scale.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work alongside an Implementation Lead, Clinical Integration, and the client's technical teams to align the application integration workstream with the overall integration effort.
## Minimum qualifications
BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
3+ years building and deploying full-stack applications into production, including integration with external APIs (React, TypeScript preferred)
Strong ability to investigate and resolve application issues end-to-end
Experience with cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, etc.) and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, etc.) in a production environment
Experience writing automated integration and end-to-end tests for production systems
Strong communicator with a demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions, working effectively with internal stakeholders, including Product Managers, to align on priorities and deliver results.
## Preferred qualifications
Experience building EHR-embedded applications such as SMART on FHIR, CDS Hooks, or Epic launch integration.
Experience rolling out production deployments, supporting systems through go-live via an on-call or support rotation, and triaging production issues
Experience working with enterprise customers, and the agility and responsiveness they require.
Experience building internal tooling or automation, including leveraging LLMs, to improve engineering velocity

description:
About us:
Articul8 was born from a simple belief: GenAI should work for the enterprise, not the other way around. Our platform — combining domain-specific models, autonomous agentic reasoning (ModelMesh™), reliable model evaluation (LLM-IQ™), and multimodal understanding — serves regulated industries such energy, semiconductor, finance, aerospace, supply chain, and more. Trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises, we bring together research, engineering, product, and domain expertise to deliver AI that meets the accuracy, explainability, and auditability standards that high-stakes environments demand.
Job Description:
Articul8 AI is seeking an exceptional Product/Software Engineer-Infrastructure to join us in shaping the future of Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI). We are looking for a Product/Software Engineer-Infrastructure with a proven track record of designing, and building scalable, reliable, and cost-effective clou-based products and solutions. As a member of our Product Technology team, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our infrastructure landscape, ensuring seamless integration, scalability, and reliability across our GenAI-driven products and services. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive innovation, optimize performance, and foster growth. This position offers exciting opportunities to work closely with cross-functional teams and external partners to drive innovations in enterprise-grade GenAI.
Responsibilities:
Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and improve our cloud-based infrastructure, focusing on high availability, low latency, and cost-effectiveness.
Collaborate closely with engineering and research teams to integrate infrastructure components with product features, ensuring optimal system performance and user experience.
Be the subject matter expert in infrastructure when designing new products and introducing new technology to our existing product line.
Develop automation scripts, tools, and frameworks to streamline deployment, monitoring, and maintenance processes.
Implement robust security measures, adhering to industry standards and best practices, to safeguard sensitive data and prevent potential vulnerabilities.
Analyze performance metrics, identifying areas for optimization and proposing data-driven improvements.
Participate in code reviews, contribute to open-source projects, and mentor junior engineers.
Stay up-to-date with emerging trends, technologies, and methodologies, applying this knowledge to enhance our infrastructure capabilities.
Required Qualifications:
Professional experience: 7+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience.
Education: BSc degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Preferred Qualifications:
Technology stack:
Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansile, etc.
Configuration Management: Ansible, Puppet, Chef
Container Orchestration: Kubernetes, Docker Swarm
Monitoring and Logging: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana).
Programming/ Development: Python, Node.js, Bash, Go, Ruby, CI/CD pipelines, and version control.
Education: Master’s or PhD in Computer science or related technical fields.
Professional Attributes (Code42):
Practice Humility: You ask questions even when you think you know the answer. You seek feedback early, learn from anyone regardless of title, and treat every experiment — especially the failures — as data.
Bias for Outcomes: You measure your work by what changed, not what you tried. You ship results, not slide decks. When a deadline is real, you find a way.
Care Deeply: You treat every problem as yours to solve. You review your own work with the rigor you'd want from a reviewer. You help teammates without being asked.
Dare to Do the Impossible & Embrace Scarcity: You set goals that make you uncomfortable. When told something can't be done, you find a way or a better question. Constraints sharpen your thinking, not slow it down.
Build a Better World: You believe AI should make things meaningfully better for real people. You hold yourself accountable not just for whether your model works, but for what it does in the world.

title: Junior Specialist Automation & AI (m/w/d)
description:

Corporate Benefits – Attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte und Vergünstigungen auf unser Sortiment.

## Deine Rolle
Du möchtest Prozesse smarter gestalten, neue Technologien ausprobieren und die Möglichkeiten künstlicher Intelligenz aktiv nutzen? Dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! In Deiner Rolle als Junior Specialist Automation & AI unterstützt Du uns dabei, interne Abläufe durch intelligente Automatisierungen effizienter zu gestalten und neue Potenziale zu erschließen. Du entwickelst und optimierst Workflows mit Tools wie n8n, integrierst APIs und setzt KI-Modelle gezielt ein, um unsere Systeme und Prozesse weiterzuentwickeln. Dabei bringst Du sowohl konkrete Anforderungen aus den Fachbereichen als auch eigene Ideen ein. • Du nimmst Automatisierungsanforderungen aus den Fachbereichen auf und setzt passende Lösungen mit n8n um – sowohl mit als auch ohne KI.

• Du dokumentierst entwickelte Lösungen und Prozesse, um Wissen nachhaltig im Team zu verankern.
• Du unterstützt die Teamleitung bei Auswertungen, Analysen und Anfragen aus den Fachbereichen.
## Das bringst Du mit
• Du hast eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium im IT- oder technischen Umfeld erfolgreich abgeschlossen.

• Du arbeitest sorgfältig, gehst verantwortungsbewusst mit Daten um und erkennst Unstimmigkeiten.

title: Data Engineer – Data Warehouse & AI Foundation (m/w/d)
description:
## Das baust du mit uns auf
Gute Analysen und hilfreiche KI brauchen eine verlässliche Grundlage. Du baust die Datenstrecken und Wissensbasen dafür mit auf.
Wir bauen ein neues digitales Brokerage auf – mit dem Rückhalt der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe. Als Data Engineer – Data Warehouse & AI Foundation verbindest du Bank-, App-, Marketing- und Marktdaten und machst sie für Fachbereiche und KI-Anwendungen nutzbar. Du entwickelst unser Data Warehouse weiter und gestaltest mit, wie Daten und internes Wissen für neue Anwendungen bereitstehen.
## Das wirst du bei uns machen
Diese Stelle besetzen wir zweimal und suchen demnach unterschiedliche Stärken: Du bringst deine Erfahrung im Data Warehouse, in der Datenintegration oder im Aufbau von KI-Wissensbasen ein. Gemeinsam besprechen wir, wo dein Schwerpunkt zu unseren Aufgaben passt.
Du entwickelst unser Data Warehouse weiter, baust Datenstrecken auf und arbeitest auch auf der Datenplattform der Atruvia (DIP).
Du bindest Bank-, App-, Marketing- und Marktdaten an und modellierst Datenprodukte für Fachbereiche und KI-Anwendungen.
Du baust die technische Grundlage einer zentralen KI-Wissensbasis auf und machst freigegebene Regelwerke, Prozesse und Anleitungen strukturiert nutzbar.
Du sicherst die Qualität von Daten und Wissensinhalten durch automatisierte Prüfungen und klärst Abweichungen mit den fachlich Verantwortlichen.
Du überwachst Datenpipelines im Betrieb, analysierst Fehler und sorgst dafür, dass Daten zuverlässig und aktuell bereitstehen.
Du setzt abgestimmte Datenschutz- und Zugriffsanforderungen technisch um und stellst sicher, dass KI-Anwendungen nur die für sie freigegebenen Daten und Inhalte nutzen können.
Du arbeitest eng mit Data Analysts, Data Scientists und GenAI Engineers zusammen und stellst die benötigten Daten und Wissensquellen bereit.
Du übersetzt Anforderungen der Fachbereiche in konkrete Datenlösungen und priorisierst die Umsetzung gemeinsam mit ihnen.
Du testest, versionierst und dokumentierst deine Lösungen so, dass sie nachvollziehbar betrieben und weiterentwickelt werden können.
## Ein Plus, aber kein Muss
Erfahrung mit Databricks, Spark oder Azure-Datendiensten.
Erfahrung mit KI-Wissensbasen, beispielsweise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Vektorsuche oder der Anbindung von SharePoint-Inhalten.
Erfahrung mit Bankdaten oder der Datenplattform der Atruvia (DIP).
Kenntnisse der für Daten- und KI-Anwendungen relevanten Datenschutzanforderungen.
Kenntnisse in Power BI oder Tableau.
## Das bringst du mit
Du hast ein Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Praxiserfahrung mit.
Du hast bereits eigenständig Datenstrecken und Data-Warehouse-Lösungen aufgebaut und in den produktiven Einsatz gebracht.
Du beherrschst SQL und Python und hast fundierte Erfahrung in der Datenmodellierung sowie der Entwicklung von Datenintegrationsprozessen.
Du hast mit einer Cloud-Datenplattform gearbeitet und kannst dich in neue Plattformen und Werkzeuge einarbeiten.
Du kennst die Anforderungen an einen verlässlichen Betrieb von Datenpipelines und kannst Fehler systematisch analysieren und beheben.
Du verstehst, wie KI-Assistenten Informationen nutzen und welche Anforderungen daraus an Aktualität, Qualität und Zugriffsrechte von Wissensquellen entstehen.
Du kennst die für deine Aufgaben relevanten Anforderungen des EU AI Act.
Du arbeitest mit Versionsverwaltung, testest deinen Code und dokumentierst deine Lösungen nachvollziehbar.
Du klärst fachliche Anforderungen verständlich, arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und setzt gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten klare Prioritäten.
## Das erwartet dich bei uns

Wachstum statt Stillstand: Wir haben viel vor und unser Team wächst. Du kannst die nächsten Schritte aktiv mitprägen und gemeinsam mit uns Neues entwickeln.

title: Insights & Data Analyst / BI Developer (m/w/d)
description:
Little Dot Studios Deutschland ist eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Social-Media-Agentur, ein Multi-Plattform-Produktionsunternehmen und digitales Mediennetzwerk – und zählt zu den weltweit führenden YouTube-Spezialisten für Marken aus Entertainment, Sport und Industrie (u. a. ARD, YouTube Health, MAN Trucks & Bus oder Creators wie Matthias Malmedie).
Vom Standort München aus sind wir Teil eines globalen Teams von über 500 Digital-Expert*innen in UK, US, Deutschland und APAC. Gemeinsam betreuen wir mehr als 1.000 digitale Kanäle, betreiben über 250 eigene Social-Media- und sechs FAST-Channels und generieren weltweit über 11 Milliarden organische Views pro Monat. Damit diese Inhalte ihre Ziele erreichen, brauchen wir genau dich in unserem Team Data & Insights!
Für unsere Team am Standort München oder remote deutschlandweit suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Insights & Data Analyst / BI Developer (m/w/d) in Teilzeit (25 Std./Woche) – zunächst befristet auf 1 Jahr (mit Perspektive auf Verlängerung).
Du hast eine Leidenschaft für Daten, Analysen und das Erlernen neuer Fähigkeiten. Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
## Aufgaben
Datenanalyse & Performance-Optimierung: Du analysierst und verarbeitest große Datenmengen rund um Social Media, SEO, Paid Search und digitales Marketing, behältst alle relevanten KPIs im Blick und leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.
Datenmodellierung & Automatisierung: Du baust saubere Datenmodelle in Google BigQuery, verarbeitest Daten mit SQL und Python, bindest Datenquellen über APIs an und entwickelst automatisierte Reportings sowie interaktive Dashboards in Looker.
Schnittstelle zu Kreativ- & Mediateams: Du übersetzt komplexe Zahlen in verständliche Storys, präsentierst deine Erkenntnisse souverän und unterstützt unsere Projekt-, Kreativ- und Mediateams dabei, datenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.
Vielfältige Kundenprojekte: Du treibst eigene Daten- und Insights-Projekte für ein breites Portfolio an Kunden voran – sowohl eigenverantwortlich als auch im engen Austausch mit unseren Entwicklern und Fachabteilungen.
## Qualifikation
Erfahrung: Mindestens 2 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Data/Marketing Analytics, BI, Digital Marketing oder einem verwandten Umfeld (z. B. Traffic Management).
Tech- & Daten-Skills: Sehr gute analytische Fähigkeiten sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in der Datenverarbeitung mit SQL und Python sowie Erfahrung mit Google BigQuery.
Social- & Reporting-Tools: Sicherer Umgang mit YouTube Analytics, der Meta Business Suite und gängigen BI-/Reporting-Tools (z. B. Looker Studio).
Development-Grundlagen: Erste Erfahrungen oder ein gutes Grundverständnis im Bereich Software Engineering / API-Anbindung.
Storytelling mit Daten: Du kannst komplexe technische Analysen so aufbereiten und erklären, dass auch nicht-technische Teams sie sofort verstehen und nutzen können.
Mindset: Du arbeitest akribisch, gut organisiert und proaktiv, denkst gerne über den Tellerrand hinaus und hast ein echtes Gespür für Social Media und internationale Trends.
Sprachen: Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch.
Nice-to-have (kein Muss, aber ein großes Plus):
Erfahrung mit spezialisierten Python-Libraries (z. B. Mito oder Zeitreihenanalysen mit ARIMA).
Kenntnisse in Social-Intelligence-Tools wie Tubular oder Locowise.
## Benefits
Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft: Wir bieten dir die Möglichkeit, mit deinen Analysen aktiv an unserem Wachstum mitzuwirken, echte Verantwortung zu übernehmen und unsere strategischen Entscheidungen maßgeblich zu prägen.
Liefere datenbasierte Impulse: Als wertvolles Mitglied unseres Teams hilfst du uns, Zielgruppen und Markttrends tiefgehend zu verstehen und unser Unternehmen gezielt weiterzuentwickeln. (Angepasst von „Trends deiner Generation“)
Sorge für deine Zukunft vor: Mit unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge (bAV) unterstützen wir dich dabei, schon heute langfristig und sicher für morgen zu planen. (Neu ergänzt)
Bleib fit und gesund: Mit dem EGYM Wellpass unterstützen wir dich dabei, körperlich und mental in Bestform zu bleiben.
Profitiere von flexiblen Arbeitsbedingungen: Wir legen großen Wert auf eine gute Balance – du profitierst von flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und der Möglichkeit, mobil im Homeoffice zu arbeiten.
Arbeite in einem inspirierenden Umfeld: Unser Team vereint entspannte Atmosphäre mit ehrgeizigen Zielen – hier gehen Spaß an der Arbeit und Erfolg Hand in Hand.
Erkunde vielfältige Inhalte: Mit einer breiten Palette an Themen, von Sport über True Crime bis hin zu Nachhaltigkeit, bieten wir ein spannendes Umfeld, das weit über trockene Zahlen hinausgeht.
Erlebe echten Teamgeist: Teamarbeit steht bei uns im Mittelpunkt – wir kommen regelmäßig zusammen, nicht nur in Meetings, sondern auch bei Team-Events, um den Zusammenhalt zu stärken.
Genieße die Atmosphäre im Büro: Unser Büro in der Macherei bietet nicht nur hervorragenden Kaffee, sondern auch die Gelegenheit, nach der Arbeit bei einem gemeinsamen Getränk zu entspannen.
Bitte bewirb dich ausschließlich auf Englisch (mit deinem englischen CV und gerne auch einem Anschreiben auf Englisch). Deine Bewerbung geht bei Anna ein, die dir auch vorab gerne deine Fragen beantwortet.
Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

title: Software Engineer, Web Development

• Kreative Problemlösung – auch für Machine-Learning-Aufgaben

Für diese Position bieten wir ein Fixgehalt im Bereich von 50.000 bis 60.000 EUR pro Jahr, abhängig von deinen individuellen Stärken und Erfahrungen. Uns ist wichtig, dass du von Anfang an weißt, woran du bist – deshalb kommunizieren wir die Gehaltsrange offen und transparent. À propos d’Adopt AI – Grand Palais

Du 30 novembre et 2 décembre 2027, Artefact Open Innovation organise la 4ᵉ édition d’Adopt AI – Grand Palais, le sommet international de référence dédié à l’intelligence artificielle.

Organisé au Grand Palais à Paris, l’événement réunira plus de 20 000 participants, 800 intervenants et 250 exposants.
Son ambition est triple :

  • Inspirer, grâce à des intervenants internationaux de renom partageant leur vision

À propos d’Artefact Open Innovation

Chez Artefact Open Innovation, nous sommes des entrepreneurs convaincus que la compétitivité, l’efficacité et la transformation des grandes organisations se gagnent en développant de nouvelles formes de collaborations et une compréhension des enjeux liés à l’adoption des nouvelles technologies – notamment DATA et IA.

Pour cela, nous partageons et propageons l’esprit entrepreneur avec des modes de collaboration plus agiles à l’échelle :

Communication et stratégie de marque

  • Contribution à la structuration de packages de communication

title: Functional Architect – AI-Driven Engineering
description:
## Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution?
Vision:
As a global software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust offers an integrated suite of legal and governance solutions. Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world’s leading Legal Tech company.
Our Impact:
From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams across 12 offices in France, the United States, Mexico, Dubai, Morocco, Germany, Spain, Italy and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America and the Middle East.
Our Recognition:
DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the “Happy at Work” and “Tech at Work” labels every year since 2019.
## The role
DiliTrust’s R&D organization is undergoing a deep transformation toward AI-driven engineering across every role, from Product and QA to DevOps, Engineering and Architecture. In this context, business knowledge becomes a strategic asset: it must be explicit, structured and shared so that both our teams and our AI agents can consistently build the right product.
Reporting to the Head of Architecture, you will be responsible for the functional coherence of the entire DiliTrust platform, covering all business modules and internal services. You will map our business domains, define functional design standards and ensure they are applied—including by building the AI agents that automate functional validation.
This is a role with real authority and a progressive mandate. You will start as a trusted advisor to Product and Engineering teams, then progressively become the approval authority for functional design across the platform. Your ability to simplify complex systems and connect business knowledge with technical execution will be central to your impact.
## Missions:
Map the platform’s business domains: Build and maintain a comprehensive model of capabilities, processes, business rules and data entities across all business modules and internal services, starting with priority areas and expanding progressively.
Simplify and rationalize the functional landscape: Apply Domain-Driven Design to define bounded contexts, establish a ubiquitous language and map relationships between contexts. Identify overlaps, gaps and inconsistencies, and clarify shared concepts such as users, entities, documents, workflows, permissions and audit trails.
Establish functional design governance: Define principles, standards and reusable patterns; review and approve functional designs and specifications against the global model. Build a clear decision-making framework through documented rules, decision records and review rituals.
Make business knowledge usable by people and AI: Maintain a living, machine-readable source of truth comprising domain models, a business glossary and precise specifications. Support spec-driven development and embed this knowledge into the context, skills and tooling used by AI agents across R&D.
Build AI-driven functional validation: Design, build and maintain your own AI agents to check specifications, user stories and designs against the domain model and design rules. Assess and improve the functional quality and reliability of AI outputs across coding, testing and review.
Align functional and technical architecture: Work with technical architects on APIs, events and data models, ensuring that DDD bounded contexts translate into well-isolated domains within a hexagonal architecture, with business logic independent of infrastructure.
Drive cross-functional alignment: Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Designers, Engineering Managers, QA and technical architects to resolve functional inconsistencies and ensure that product and engineering decisions remain coherent across the platform.
Coach teams and champion functional practices: Act as a reference on functional topics, onboarding and coaching teams on the domain model, design standards and ways of working.
## Requirements
Based in France with full working rights.
Fluent in French and English.
## Experience & seniority:
10+ years of experience in software, including significant experience in system modeling and functional or solution design on complex B2B SaaS platforms.
Proven experience mapping and rationalizing a complex, multi-product platform with a long history.
Demonstrated ability to connect business needs, functional models and engineering decisions.
Legal Tech experience is not required.
## Technical expertise:
Strong command of strategic and tactical Domain-Driven Design: bounded contexts, ubiquitous language, context mapping, aggregates, entities, value objects and domain events.
Proficiency in process and system modeling using approaches such as BPMN, UML, C4 and event storming.
Ability to write precise specifications, business rules and acceptance criteria, including formats such as Gherkin.
Solid understanding of hexagonal architecture, APIs, data models and event-driven architectures, enabling you to engage as a peer with technical architects.
Daily use of LLM assistants and AI agents, with the ability to quickly master new tools.
Hands-on ability to build and iterate on AI agents through prompting, context engineering, skills, MCP, scripting or low-code approaches as needed.
Good understanding of how to evaluate and improve the functional accuracy and reliability of AI outputs.
## Leadership & collaboration:
Strong systems thinking: you understand the whole, recognize interactions and design for coherence over time.
A proven ability to simplify rather than add complexity, favoring clear concepts, clean boundaries and minimal models.
Structured, concise thinking and the ability to make complex topics understandable to others.
The ability to build trust and influence first, then hold a firm line on standards when needed.
Excellent communication, teaching and coaching skills across business and technical teams.
## Education:
Your background may be functional—business analysis, product or functional architecture—or technical, such as software engineering or architecture. What matters is your ability to model complex systems and bridge business and technology.

For information only: the stack evolves continuously, and hands-on expertise in every technology is not expected for this role.

Join a fast-growing company in a friendly, international environment.
