title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern - Computer Vision
description:
## About Us
Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.
Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.
## About the Role
As a Machine Learning Intern, you join the team to explore framed topics, assess their relevance and feasibility through proofs of concept, and help the strongest ideas reach production. You own your project end to end, from literature review and scoping to implementation and benchmarking, on topics shaped by live projects and production needs. You work in a fast-paced engineering team with an industrial, production-first mindset, on cutting-edge research topics in an emerging defense company where the stakes are high. You are a full member of the team, with visibility on how the company and its products evolve and a direct impact on what we ship.
## Responsibilities
Run literature reviews and state-of-the-art analyses on computer vision and machine learning topics framed by the team.
Scope projects, define tasks, and decide which approaches to benchmark, from baselines to the most prominent algorithms.
Build experimentation plans and define implementation architectures for novel approaches.
Collect, prepare, synthesize, and augment data for model training and evaluation.
Implement, train, and benchmark models across topics such as foundation models, knowledge distillation, CNNs, transformers, and embedded models.
Explore multi-sensor fusion and the processing of temporal data where projects call for it.
Evaluate results rigorously with task-specific metrics to judge relevance and feasibility.
Develop proofs of concept and support the transition of promising ones towards production.
Present concepts, results, and project status to the team and to wider audiences, and join team meetings to learn from other projects.
## Candidate Requirements
Currently pursuing an MSc in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Computer Science, or a related field.
Hands-on experience with ML projects involving model training and evaluation, ideally across different tasks and architectures such as CNNs and transformers.
Ability to select the best-performing model for a use case and to choose suitable task-specific evaluation metrics.
Familiarity with computer vision and image processing is a plus, such as classification, detection, tracking, segmentation, depth estimation, or 3D vision.
Awareness of model scale trade-offs, from large multi-GPU architectures to small optimized models on embedded platforms.
Motivated, autonomous, and proactive, with the ability to own a project and communicate results clearly.
We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Als Platform Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het volledige proces van requirements tot oplevering. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert moderne IT-infrastructuur voor uitdagende klantprojecten. Met tools zoals Terraform en Ansible til je onze automatisering naar het hoogste niveau. Je begeleidt complexe klantmigraties van A tot Z met oog voor detail. Daarnaast borg je een uitstekende overdracht en heldere documentatie voor je collega's. Zo creëer je voorspelbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige omgevingen voor maatschappelijk relevante organisaties.
Wat je zal gaan doen:
Ontwerpen en opbouwen van schaalbare IT-infrastructuur op basis van klantvereisten.
Automatiseren van omgevingen en processen met Terraform, Ansible en scripting.
Zelfstandig uitvoeren en begeleiden van complexe klantmigraties.
Inrichten van krachtige cloud- en Linux-omgevingen op platformen zoals Scaleway, AWS en Azure, volgens de nieuwste standaarden.
Opstellen van heldere documentatie en verzorgen van een vlekkeloze kennisoverdracht.
Waarborgen van de veiligheid, capaciteit en performance van het platform.
Adviseren van klanten en collega's over slimme infrastructurele keuzes.
Na succesvolle oplevering draag je de omgeving over aan onze Hosting Engineers, die het dagelijkse beheer overnemen. Jij richt je vervolgens op het volgende project.
## Wie ben jij?
We zoeken een ervaren professional met hbo werk- en denkniveau. Je voelt je thuis in Linux en Infrastructure as Code. Tools zoals Terraform en Ansible hebben voor jou geen geheimen: je bent echt een bouwer die zich als een vis in het water voelt bij deze technologieën. Je hebt ruime ervaring met het zelfstandig ontwerpen en migreren van complete IT-omgevingen. Je communiceert helder, pakt eigenaarschap en werkt gestructureerd. Verder woon je in Nederland en spreek je bij voorkeur Nederlands.
## Wat bieden wij jou?
De Organisatie: Je versterkt een snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met een sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.
Autonomie: Je krijgt veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.
Maatschappelijke Impact: Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten met een directe en tastbare maatschappelijke impact.
Salaris: Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4.500,- en €7.500,- passend bij jouw ervaring.
Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om goed uit te rusten en op te laden.
Werkplek & Sfeer: Een gezellige werksfeer op ons kantoor in Hilversum met flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en elke dag een verzorgde lunch op kantoor.
Mobiliteit & Fiets: Een kilometervergoeding van € 0,25/km of een volledige OV-vergoeding, én een fiscaal aantrekkelijk fietsplan.
Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen voor jouw toekomst.
Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor het volgen van opleidingen en trainingen om te blijven groeien, plus een jaarlijks Coolblue thuiswerkbudget van € 500,- om je werkplek perfect in te richten.
Events & Fun: Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.
## Over Dawn Technology
We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er toe doen. Denk aan de zorg, educatie, duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud. We bouwen software die logisch voelt. Precies dat maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.
Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis. We zoeken de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken elkaar. Benieuwd naar de sfeer bij Dawn Technology? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.
## Solliciteren
Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.
Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

title: AI Operations & Workflow Architect
description:
Job Title: AI Operations & Workflow Architect
Job Overview
We are building a next-generation
AI-native technology and digital platform ecosystem
. This role focuses on leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI Agent technologies to redesign and automate end-to-end workflows across software development, testing, deployment, daily operations, and business processes.
The primary objective is to delegate repetitive, rule-based execution and preliminary review tasks to AI Agents, establishing a streamlined and efficient
“AI Execution + Human-in-the-Loop Approval”
operating model. The successful candidate will build scalable and standardized automation tools that can eventually be maintained by junior team members, while continuously driving the organization toward greater operational efficiency and automation.
Key Responsibilities
1. End-to-End AI Agent Workflow Design & Implementation (Core Responsibility)
• Development & Deployment Automation: Build AI Agent workflows to automate code reviews, merge conflict detection, automated test report analysis, quality acceptance checks, and production deployment orchestration, including canary and full-scale releases.
• Operational & Business Configuration Reviews: Design AI-powered pre-review mechanisms for frequently performed business and operational configurations, such as product launch configurations, campaign parameters, pricing adjustments, and business rule changes, as well as infrastructure operations such as node scaling and database changes. Automatically validate parameter correctness, potential risks, and compliance requirements.
• Cross-System Integration: Integrate GitLab/GitHub, Jira, monitoring and alerting systems (Prometheus/Grafana), CMDB, and internal business management systems through MCP (Model Context Protocol), API gateways, and automation tools such as n8n, Dify, and LangGraph.
2. Human-in-the-Loop Governance, Security & Risk Control
• Human-in-the-Loop Approval Mechanism: Identify high-risk checkpoints within business and operational workflows, such as financial transactions, critical production system changes, and high-privilege access approvals, and design simple and intuitive approval interfaces. Approval requests may be delivered through Feishu, Telegram, or Slack cards, allowing human reviewers to assess key summaries and approve or reject actions with minimal effort.
• AI Agent Access Control & Auditability: Establish strict AI Agent authentication and least-privilege access policies based on RBAC/ABAC. Ensure all automated actions are supported by complete audit logs, rollback mechanisms, and safeguards against AI hallucinations and unauthorized execution, preventing AI errors from causing financial, operational, or system-level risks.
3. Standardization, Knowledge Transfer & Continuous Optimization
• System Maintainability & Documentation: Develop clear system architecture documentation, Prompt standards, and Agent troubleshooting manuals. Ensure automation pipelines are robust, maintainable, and easy to hand over to junior engineers or operations personnel for daily maintenance and workflow adjustments.
• Automation & ROI Optimization: Continuously monitor automation rates, human intervention rates, AI review accuracy, and risk interception effectiveness across business functions. Regularly review human approval cases and improve Prompt design and workflow logic to progressively automate manual operational tasks and preliminary review processes.
Requirements
Essential Requirements
• Strong Technical Background: Experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Backend Development, with a solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), CI/CD pipelines, and system operations.
• Hands-on AI Agent Experience: Proficient in at least one major AI workflow orchestration framework, such as Dify, n8n, Coze, LangChain, or LangGraph. Experienced in writing high-quality System Prompts and integrating LLMs with external tools and APIs/CLIs through Function Calling or MCP.
• Strong Workflow Abstraction Skills: Able to translate ambiguous business requirements, manual experience, and informal procedures into structured decision-making logic and SOPs. Clearly define which workflows can be fully automated by AI and which require human approval.
• Security & Risk Awareness: Strong understanding of access control, permission management, operational auditing, fault isolation, and system security. Able to implement AI automation while maintaining strict security and operational safeguards.
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Complex Digital Platforms: Familiarity with large-scale platform architecture, including transaction processing, payment systems, account management, data reconciliation, business risk controls, and product onboarding workflows. Understanding of high-availability architecture and the importance of system reliability, data integrity, and operational security.
• ChatOps Implementation Experience: Experience developing bots using Slack, Telegram, Feishu, or DingTalk to facilitate operational approvals, workflow automation, and command execution through instant messaging platforms.
• Engineering & Development Capabilities: Proficient in Python or Go, with the ability to independently develop lightweight middleware, webhook services, or custom MCP Servers to extend existing automation tools and system capabilities.

description:
## Job Title: AI Operations & Workflow Architect
## Job Overview
We are building a next-generation AI-native technology and digital platform ecosystem. This role focuses on leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI Agent technologies to redesign and automate end-to-end workflows across software development, testing, deployment, daily operations, and business processes.
The primary objective is to delegate repetitive, rule-based execution and preliminary review tasks to AI Agents, establishing a streamlined and efficient “AI Execution + Human-in-the-Loop Approval” operating model. The successful candidate will build scalable and standardized automation tools that can eventually be maintained by junior team members, while continuously driving the organization toward greater operational efficiency and automation.
## Key Responsibilities
## 1. End-to-End AI Agent Workflow Design & Implementation (Core Responsibility)
Development & Deployment Automation: Build AI Agent workflows to automate code reviews, merge conflict detection, automated test report analysis, quality acceptance checks, and production deployment orchestration, including canary and full-scale releases.
Operational & Business Configuration Reviews: Design AI-powered pre-review mechanisms for frequently performed business and operational configurations, such as product launch configurations, campaign parameters, pricing adjustments, and business rule changes, as well as infrastructure operations such as node scaling and database changes. Automatically validate parameter correctness, potential risks, and compliance requirements.
Cross-System Integration: Integrate GitLab/GitHub, Jira, monitoring and alerting systems (Prometheus/Grafana), CMDB, and internal business management systems through MCP (Model Context Protocol), API gateways, and automation tools such as n8n, Dify, and LangGraph.
## 2. Human-in-the-Loop Governance, Security & Risk Control
Human-in-the-Loop Approval Mechanism: Identify high-risk checkpoints within business and operational workflows, such as financial transactions, critical production system changes, and high-privilege access approvals, and design simple and intuitive approval interfaces. Approval requests may be delivered through Feishu, Telegram, or Slack cards, allowing human reviewers to assess key summaries and approve or reject actions with minimal effort.
AI Agent Access Control & Auditability: Establish strict AI Agent authentication and least-privilege access policies based on RBAC/ABAC. Ensure all automated actions are supported by complete audit logs, rollback mechanisms, and safeguards against AI hallucinations and unauthorized execution, preventing AI errors from causing financial, operational, or system-level risks.
## 3. Standardization, Knowledge Transfer & Continuous Optimization
System Maintainability & Documentation: Develop clear system architecture documentation, Prompt standards, and Agent troubleshooting manuals. Ensure automation pipelines are robust, maintainable, and easy to hand over to junior engineers or operations personnel for daily maintenance and workflow adjustments.
Automation & ROI Optimization: Continuously monitor automation rates, human intervention rates, AI review accuracy, and risk interception effectiveness across business functions. Regularly review human approval cases and improve Prompt design and workflow logic to progressively automate manual operational tasks and preliminary review processes.
## Requirements
## Essential Requirements
Strong Technical Background: Experience in DevOps, SRE, Platform Engineering, or Backend Development, with a solid understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), CI/CD pipelines, and system operations.
Hands-on AI Agent Experience: Proficient in at least one major AI workflow orchestration framework, such as Dify, n8n, Coze, LangChain, or LangGraph. Experienced in writing high-quality System Prompts and integrating LLMs with external tools and APIs/CLIs through Function Calling or MCP.
Strong Workflow Abstraction Skills: Able to translate ambiguous business requirements, manual experience, and informal procedures into structured decision-making logic and SOPs. Clearly define which workflows can be fully automated by AI and which require human approval.
Security & Risk Awareness: Strong understanding of access control, permission management, operational auditing, fault isolation, and system security. Able to implement AI automation while maintaining strict security and operational safeguards.
## Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Complex Digital Platforms: Familiarity with large-scale platform architecture, including transaction processing, payment systems, account management, data reconciliation, business risk controls, and product onboarding workflows. Understanding of high-availability architecture and the importance of system reliability, data integrity, and operational security.
ChatOps Implementation Experience: Experience developing bots using Slack, Telegram, Feishu, or DingTalk to facilitate operational approvals, workflow automation, and command execution through instant messaging platforms.
Engineering & Development Capabilities: Proficient in Python or Go, with the ability to independently develop lightweight middleware, webhook services, or custom MCP Servers to extend existing automation tools and system capabilities.
